commonStatement.en: Regional, District, Ward and Village Disaster Management Committees are required to take appropriate measures to prepare for and respond to disasters in order to reduce the impacts of disasters.
commonStatement.sw: Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa za Mikoa, Wilaya, Kata na Vijiji zinatakiwa kuchukua hatua stahiki za kujiandaa na kukabiliana na maafa ili kupunguza athari za majanga.

rows.impactEn: Reduced visibility on roads during rainfall
rows.impactSw: Kupungua kwa uwezo wa kuona barabarani wakati wa mvua
rows.actionEn: Drive slowly with headlights on. Keep a safe distance from other vehicles. Avoid unnecessary travel.
rows.actionSw: Endesha taratibu ukiwasha taa za mbele. Weka umbali salama kati yako na magari mengine. Epuka safari zisizo za lazima.

rows.impactEn: Slippery and water-covered roads in few areas
rows.impactSw: Barabara zinazoteleza na zilizofunikwa na maji katika maeneo machache
rows.actionEn: Avoid sudden braking. Reduce speed. Pedestrians should use elevated walkways.
rows.actionSw: Epuka kukanyaga breki ghafla. Punguza mwendo. Watembea kwa miguu watumie vijia vya juu.

rows.impactEn: Few homes affected by surface water
rows.impactSw: Makazi machache kuathiriwa na maji yaliyojaa juu ya ardhi
rows.actionEn: Clear blocked drains around homes. Raise valuables above the floor. Place sandbags at doorways where needed.
rows.actionSw: Safisha mitaro iliyoziba karibu na nyumba. Inua vitu vya thamani juu ya sakafu. Weka magunia ya mchanga milangoni inapohitajika.

rows.impactEn: Disruption of social and economic activities in few areas
rows.impactSw: Kuathirika kwa shughuli za kijamii na kiuchumi katika maeneo machache
rows.actionEn: Special groups including people with disabilities, children and the elderly should be given early warning information and appropriate measures should be taken by the community concerned. Continue to follow weather information from the Tanzania Meteorological Authority.
rows.actionSw: Makundi maalum ikijumuisha watu wenye ulemavu, watoto na wazee wapatiwe taarifa ya tahadhari ya mapema na hatua stahiki zichukuliwe na jamii husika. Endelea kufuatilia taarifa za hali ya hewa zinazotolewa na Mamlaka ya Hali ya Hewa Tanzania.

rows.impactEn: Possibility of isolated lightning strikes
rows.impactSw: Uwezekano wa mapigo ya radi katika maeneo machache
rows.actionEn: Stay indoors during thunderstorms. Avoid trees, open fields and metal objects. Unplug electrical equipment.
rows.actionSw: Kaa ndani wakati wa radi. Epuka miti, maeneo ya wazi na vitu vya chuma. Toa vifaa vya umeme kwenye soketi.

rows.impactEn: Risk of children falling into open wells or drains hidden by water
rows.impactSw: Hatari ya watoto kuanguka kwenye visima vilivyo wazi au mitaro iliyofunikwa na maji
rows.actionEn: Cover open wells and drains. Keep children away from areas with standing water.
rows.actionSw: Funika visima vilivyo wazi na mitaro. Waweke watoto mbali na maeneo yenye maji yaliyotuama.

rows.impactEn: Localised soil erosion and waterlogging of farmland
rows.impactSw: Mmomonyoko wa udongo na kujaa kwa maji shambani katika maeneo machache
rows.actionEn: Open drainage furrows in fields. Protect newly planted crops. Postpone field operations on saturated soil.
rows.actionSw: Fungua mitaro ya maji shambani. Linda mazao yaliyopandwa upya. Ahirisha kazi za shambani ikiwa udongo umejaa maji.

rows.impactEn: Increased breeding of mosquitoes in stagnant water
rows.impactSw: Kuongezeka kwa kuzaliana kwa mbu kwenye maji yaliyotuama
rows.actionEn: Drain stagnant water around homes. Cover water containers. Sleep under treated bed nets.
rows.actionSw: Ondoa maji yaliyotuama karibu na nyumba. Funika vyombo vya maji. Lala chini ya vyandarua vyenye dawa.

rows.impactEn: Possibility of weak roofs leaking or being damaged
rows.impactSw: Uwezekano wa paa dhaifu kuvuja au kuharibika
rows.actionEn: Inspect and repair roofs before heavy rain. Place buckets under leaks. Move belongings away from leaking spots.
rows.actionSw: Kagua na rekebisha paa kabla ya mvua kubwa. Weka ndoo chini ya sehemu zinazovuja. Ondoa vitu kutoka maeneo yanayovuja.

rows.impactEn: Risk of isolated landslides in few hazardous areas
rows.impactSw: Hatari ya maporomoko ya ardhi katika maeneo machache hatarishi
rows.actionEn: Avoid steep slopes. Monitor cracks and soil movements. Relocate when you see signs of soil collapse.
rows.actionSw: Epuka miteremko mikali. Fuatilia nyufa na mienendo ya udongo. Hama ukiona dalili za kuporomoka kwa udongo.

rows.impactEn: Significantly reduced visibility on roads
rows.impactSw: Kupungua kwa kiasi kikubwa kwa uwezo wa kuona barabarani
rows.actionEn: Avoid unnecessary travel. If travelling drive slowly with headlights on. Allow extra travel time.
rows.actionSw: Epuka safari zisizo za lazima. Ukisafiri endesha taratibu ukiwasha taa za mbele. Weka muda wa ziada wa safari.

rows.impactEn: Many areas affected by heavy rainfall and surface water flooding
rows.impactSw: Maeneo mengi kuathiriwa na mvua kubwa na mafuriko ya maji ya juu ya ardhi
rows.actionEn: Identify safe areas. Relocate those at risk if needed. Cooperate with local leaders.
rows.actionSw: Tambua maeneo salama. Wahamishe walio hatarini ikihitajika. Shirikiana na viongozi wa eneo.

rows.impactEn: Travel delays and some roads becoming impassable
rows.impactSw: Ucheleweshaji wa safari na baadhi ya barabara kutopitika
rows.actionEn: Avoid non-essential travel. Follow designated alternative routes. Allow extra travel time.
rows.actionSw: Epuka safari zisizo za lazima. Fuata njia mbadala zilizoelekezwa. Weka muda wa ziada wa safari.

rows.impactEn: Threat to life from frequent lightning strikes
rows.impactSw: Hatari ya maisha kutokana na mapigo ya mara kwa mara ya radi
rows.actionEn: Stay indoors. Avoid trees, open fields, water bodies and metal objects. Unplug electrical and electronic equipment.
rows.actionSw: Kaa ndani. Epuka miti, maeneo ya wazi, sehemu zenye maji na vitu vya chuma. Toa vifaa vya umeme na elektroniki kwenye soketi.

rows.impactEn: Damage to standing crops from waterlogging and runoff
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu wa mazao yaliyo shambani kutokana na kujaa kwa maji na mtiririko wa maji
rows.actionEn: Open drainage in fields where possible. Harvest mature crops early. Report damage to agricultural extension officers.
rows.actionSw: Fungua mitaro ya maji shambani inapowezekana. Vuna mazao yaliyokomaa mapema. Toa taarifa ya uharibifu kwa maafisa ugani wa kilimo.

rows.impactEn: Outbreak of malaria, diarrhoea and waterborne infections from contaminated water
rows.impactSw: Mlipuko wa malaria, kuhara na maambukizi yanayoenezwa na maji yaliyochafuka
rows.actionEn: Treat or boil drinking water. Avoid contact with floodwater. Observe hand hygiene. Sleep under treated bed nets.
rows.actionSw: Tibu au chemsha maji ya kunywa. Epuka kugusa maji ya mafuriko. Zingatia usafi wa mikono. Lala chini ya vyandarua vyenye dawa.

rows.impactEn: Damage to roofs and weak buildings from prolonged rainfall
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu wa paa na majengo dhaifu kutokana na mvua za muda mrefu
rows.actionEn: Move out of weak or damaged buildings. Secure roofing where possible. Report damage to local authorities.
rows.actionSw: Hama kutoka majengo dhaifu au yaliyoharibika. Imarisha paa inapowezekana. Toa taarifa ya uharibifu kwa mamlaka za eneo.

rows.impactEn: Trees falling on roads, power infrastructure and buildings due to saturated soil
rows.impactSw: Miti kuanguka barabarani, kwenye miundombinu ya umeme na majengo kutokana na udongo uliojaa maji
rows.actionEn: Avoid sheltering under trees. Report fallen trees to local authorities. Keep distance from broken power lines.
rows.actionSw: Epuka kujihifadhi chini ya miti. Toa taarifa ya miti iliyoanguka kwa mamlaka za eneo. Weka umbali na nyaya za umeme zilizokatika.

rows.impactEn: Significant disruption to infrastructure, water and electricity supply
rows.impactSw: Kuathirika kwa kiasi kikubwa kwa miundombinu, huduma ya maji na umeme
rows.actionEn: Stock essential supplies (water, food, medicines). Prepare for loss of electricity and communication.
rows.actionSw: Weka akiba ya mahitaji muhimu (maji, chakula, dawa). Jjiandae kukosekana kwa umeme na mawasiliano.

rows.impactEn: Closure of schools in affected areas
rows.impactSw: Kufungwa kwa shule katika maeneo yaliyoathirika
rows.actionEn: Follow education authority directives. Arrange temporary studies at home.
rows.actionSw: Fuata maelekezo ya mamlaka za elimu. Panga masomo ya muda nyumbani.

rows.impactEn: High risk of landslides in hazardous areas
rows.impactSw: Hatari kubwa ya maporomoko ya ardhi katika maeneo hatarishi
rows.actionEn: Avoid steep slopes. Monitor cracks and soil movements. Relocate when you see warning signs.
rows.actionSw: Epuka miteremko mikali. Fuatilia nyufa na mienendo ya udongo. Hama ukiona dalili za hatari.

rows.impactEn: Evacuation of people from hazardous areas may be necessary
rows.impactSw: Inaweza kuwa muhimu kuhamisha watu kutoka maeneo hatarishi
rows.actionEn: Prepare an evacuation plan and emergency bag. Identify nearby temporary shelters.
rows.actionSw: Andaa mpango wa uhamishaji na begi la dharura. Tambua makazi ya muda yaliyo karibu.

rows.impactEn: Severe widespread heavy rainfall affecting whole communities
rows.impactSw: Mvua kubwa iliyoenea inayoathiri jamii nzima
rows.actionEn: Implement community-wide evacuation. Prioritise those at risk. Use official shelters.
rows.actionSw: Tekeleza uhamishaji wa jamii nzima. Wape kipaumbele walio hatarini. Tumia makazi rasmi.

rows.impactEn: Severe loss of visibility making travel extremely dangerous
rows.impactSw: Kupungua sana kwa uwezo wa kuona kunakofanya safari kuwa hatari kubwa
rows.actionEn: Stay home if possible. Do not travel unless absolutely necessary. Follow official directives.
rows.actionSw: Kaa nyumbani ikiwezekana. Usisafiri isipokuwa ni lazima kabisa. Fuata maelekezo rasmi.

rows.impactEn: Loss of life from drowning, lightning strikes and electrocution
rows.impactSw: Vifo kutokana na kuzama majini, kupigwa na radi na kupigwa na umeme
rows.actionEn: Do not enter fast or deep water. Stay indoors during lightning. Keep distance from broken power lines. Contact emergency services.
rows.actionSw: Usivuke maji yenye kasi au kina kirefu. Kaa ndani wakati kuna radi. Weka umbali na nyaya za umeme zilizokatika. Wasiliana na vyombo vya dharura.

rows.impactEn: Major landslides in steep-sided areas due to saturated soil
rows.impactSw: Maporomoko makubwa ya ardhi katika maeneo yenye miteremko mikali kutokana na udongo uliojaa maji
rows.actionEn: Suspend all activities on steep slopes. Install warning signs. Relocate to safe areas immediately.
rows.actionSw: Sitisha shughuli zote kwenye miteremko mikali. Weka alama za onyo. Hama kwenda maeneo salama mara moja.

rows.impactEn: Collapse of buildings and major damage to infrastructure
rows.impactSw: Kuanguka kwa majengo na uharibifu mkubwa wa miundombinu
rows.actionEn: Move out of weak or affected buildings. Establish restriction zones. Avoid riverbanks and water channels.
rows.actionSw: Hama majengo dhaifu au yaliyoathirika. Weka maeneo ya zuio. Epuka kingo za mito na mikondo ya maji.

rows.impactEn: Severe damage to crops, food stores and livestock
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu mkubwa wa mazao, akiba ya chakula na mifugo
rows.actionEn: Move and protect food reserves and livestock to safe places. Coordinate emergency assistance with district authorities.
rows.actionSw: Hamisha na linda akiba ya chakula na mifugo mahali salama. Ratibu msaada wa dharura na mamlaka za wilaya.

rows.impactEn: Severe disease outbreaks (cholera and malaria) from contaminated water
rows.impactSw: Mlipuko mkubwa wa magonjwa (kipindupindu na malaria) kutokana na maji yaliyochafuka
rows.actionEn: Ensure safe drinking water. Use ORS for diarrhoea. Use bed nets. Seek medical treatment promptly.
rows.actionSw: Hakikisha maji salama ya kunywa. Tumia ORS kwa kuhara. Tumia vyandarua. Tafuta matibabu mapema.

rows.impactEn: Long-term loss of essential services and infrastructure
rows.impactSw: Upotevu wa muda mrefu wa huduma na miundombinu muhimu
rows.actionEn: Prepare for loss of services for several days. Establish community resource centres (water, information, health).
rows.actionSw: Jiandae kukosa huduma kwa siku kadhaa. Weka vituo vya rasilimali vya jamii (maji, taarifa, afya).

rows.impactEn: Large-scale evacuation of people may be required
rows.impactSw: Uhamishaji mkubwa wa watu unaweza kuhitajika
rows.actionEn: Implement evacuation plan. Register at shelters. Assist those with special needs.
rows.actionSw: Tekeleza mpango wa uhamishaji. Jisajili kwenye makazi. Saidia wenye uhitaji maalum.

rows.impactEn: Closure of schools in many areas
rows.impactSw: Kufungwa kwa shule katika maeneo mengi
rows.actionEn: Provide remote learning options. Ensure safety before reopening.
rows.actionSw: Toa chaguo za masomo ya mbali. Hakikisha usalama kabla ya kufungua tena.

rows.impactEn: Severe traffic disruption with major roads becoming impassable
rows.impactSw: Kuathirika kwa kiasi kikubwa kwa usafiri na barabara kuu kutopitika
rows.actionEn: Stay home if possible. Keep emergency routes clear. Follow official directives.
rows.actionSw: Kaa nyumbani ikiwezekana. Ziache wazi njia za dharura. Fuata maelekezo rasmi.

rows.impactEn: Few homes surrounded by water
rows.impactSw: Makazi machache kuzingirwa na maji
rows.actionEn: Avoid crossing roads and bridges filled with water
rows.actionSw: Epuka kuvuka barabara na madaraja yaliyojaa maji

rows.impactEn: Minor damage to road and bridge infrastructure
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu mdogo wa miundombinu ya barabara na madaraja
rows.actionEn: Take precautions for people living in valley and low-lying areas

rows.actionSw: Makundi maalum ikijumuisha watu wenye ulemavu, watoto na wazee wapatiwe taarifa ya tahadhari ya mapema na hatua stahiki zichukuliwe na jamii husika

rows.impactSw: Kuathirika kwa shughuli za kijamii na kiuchumi
rows.actionEn: Continue to follow weather information provided by the Tanzania Meteorological Authority
rows.actionSw: Endelea kufuatilia taarifa za hali ya hewa zinazotolewa na Mamlaka ya Hali ya Hewa Tanzania

rows.actionSw: Epuka madaraja ya mbao. Tumia njia mbadala zilizoainishwa. Ripoti hatari iliyopo katika eneo husika.

rows.actionSw: Weka akiba ya mahitaji muhimu. Jiandae kukosekana kwa umeme na mawasiliano kwa muda mfupi.

rows.impactSw: Hatari iliyoongezeka ya maporomoko ya ardhi katika miteremko mikali na maeneo yaliyoathirika hapo awali
rows.actionEn: Identify safe areas and evacuation routes. Review household emergency plans. Continue to follow weather information from the Tanzania Meteorological Authority.

rows.impactSw: Udongo uliojaa maji kudhoofisha misingi ya nyumba zilizo kwenye miteremko
rows.actionEn: Inspect foundations for cracks before heavy rain. Clear roof gutters and channel runoff away from buildings. Redirect stormwater away from slopes.
rows.actionSw: Kagua misingi kuangalia nyufa kabla ya mvua kubwa. Safisha mifereji ya paa na elekeza maji mbali na majengo. Elekeza maji ya mvua mbali na miteremko.

rows.impactEn: Visible slow ground movement: new cracks on roads, walls and pavements
rows.impactSw: Mienendo ya polepole ya ardhi inayoonekana: nyufa mpya kwenye barabara, kuta na vijia
rows.actionEn: Mark and report observed cracks to local authorities. Avoid building or planting on visibly cracked ground. Monitor cracks daily for widening.
rows.actionSw: Weka alama na toa taarifa ya nyufa unazoziona kwa mamlaka za eneo. Epuka kujenga au kupanda kwenye ardhi yenye nyufa zinazoonekana. Fuatilia nyufa kila siku ili kuona kama zinaongezeka.

rows.impactEn: Difficulty opening or closing doors and windows in hillside homes (early warning sign of slope movement)
rows.impactSw: Ugumu wa kufungua au kufunga milango na madirisha katika nyumba zilizo kwenye miteremko (dalili ya mapema ya mienendo ya mteremko)
rows.actionEn: If doors or windows start sticking, inspect walls and foundations for new cracks. Consider relocating from the building until checked by local authorities.
rows.actionSw: Milango au madirisha yakianza kuwa magumu kufungua au kufunga, kagua kuta na misingi kuangalia nyufa mpya. Fikiria kuhama kutoka jengo hadi mamlaka za eneo zikague.

rows.impactEn: Tilting of trees, fences and utility poles on slopes
rows.impactSw: Miti, ua na nguzo za umeme kuinama kwenye miteremko
rows.actionEn: Avoid the area beneath leaning trees and poles. Report observations to local authorities. Do not park vehicles or hold gatherings near leaning structures.
rows.actionSw: Epuka eneo lililo chini ya miti na nguzo zinazoinama. Toa taarifa kwa mamlaka za eneo. Usiegeshe magari wala kufanya mikusanyiko karibu na miundo inayoinama.

rows.impactEn: New springs or wet patches appearing where there was no water before
rows.impactSw: Chemchemi mpya au unyevu kwenye ardhi mahali ambapo hapakuwa na maji hapo awali
rows.actionEn: Report new springs or unusual wet patches to local authorities. Do not build or excavate near these areas. The appearance of new water on a slope is a serious warning sign.
rows.actionSw: Toa taarifa kwa mamlaka za eneo kuhusu chemchemi mpya au unyevu usio wa kawaida. Usijenge wala kuchimba karibu na maeneo hayo. Kuonekana kwa maji mapya kwenye mteremko ni dalili kubwa ya hatari.

rows.impactEn: Possible blocking of mountain drainage channels and culverts
rows.impactSw: Uwezekano wa kuziba kwa mifereji ya maji ya milimani na mitaro ya barabara
rows.actionEn: Clear blocked drains, gutters and culverts before heavy rain. Report blocked drainage to local authorities. Do not dump waste in waterways.
rows.actionSw: Safisha mitaro, mifereji ya paa na mitaro ya barabara kabla ya mvua kubwa. Toa taarifa kwa mamlaka za eneo kuhusu mifereji iliyoziba. Usitupe taka kwenye mifereji ya maji.

rows.impactEn: Disruption to terraced farms and hillside cultivation
rows.impactSw: Kuathirika kwa mashamba ya matuta na kilimo kwenye miteremko
rows.actionEn: Strengthen terrace walls and check field drainage. Postpone field operations on saturated slopes. Replant trees and grass to stabilise soil.
rows.actionSw: Imarisha kuta za matuta na kagua mifereji ya maji shambani. Ahirisha kazi za shambani kwenye miteremko iliyojaa maji. Panda upya miti na nyasi ili kuimarisha udongo.

rows.impactEn: Possible isolated minor rockfalls on mountain roads
rows.impactSw: Uwezekano wa kuanguka kwa mawe madogo katika maeneo machache kwenye barabara za milimani
rows.actionEn: Drive with extreme caution on mountain roads. Avoid stopping below cliffs and steep slopes. Report fallen rocks to road authorities.
rows.actionSw: Endesha kwa tahadhari kubwa kwenye barabara za milimani. Epuka kusimama chini ya majabali na miteremko mikali. Toa taarifa kwa mamlaka za barabara kuhusu mawe yaliyoanguka.

rows.impactEn: Vulnerable groups in landslide-prone areas at higher risk
rows.impactSw: Makundi ya watu walio katika hatari katika maeneo yanayoshambuliwa na maporomoko ya ardhi
rows.actionEn: Special groups including people with disabilities, children and the elderly should be given early warning information and appropriate measures should be taken by the community concerned
rows.actionSw: Makundi maalum ikijumuisha watu wenye ulemavu, watoto na wazee wapatiwe taarifa ya tahadhari ya mapema na hatua stahiki zichukuliwe na jamii husika

rows.impactEn: Partial slope failures and small landslides occurring in vulnerable areas
rows.impactSw: Kuporomoka kwa sehemu za miteremko na maporomoko madogo ya ardhi kutokea katika maeneo hatarishi
rows.actionEn: Identify safe areas and evacuation routes. Relocate at-risk households immediately. • cooperate with local leaders.
rows.actionSw: Tambua maeneo salama na njia za uhamishaji. Wahamishe kaya zilizo hatarini mara moja. Shirikiana na viongozi wa eneo.

rows.impactEn: Damage to homes, walls and structures from ground movement
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu wa nyumba, kuta na miundo kutokana na mienendo ya ardhi
rows.actionEn: Move out of damaged buildings. Mark dangerous structures clearly. Report damage to local authorities.
rows.actionSw: Hama kutoka majengo yaliyoharibika. Weka alama wazi kwenye miundo hatarishi. Toa taarifa ya uharibifu kwa mamlaka za eneo.

rows.impactEn: Mountain roads and small bridges blocked by debris (mud, stones and trees)
rows.impactSw: Barabara za milimani na madaraja madogo kuzibwa na uchafu (matope, mawe na miti)
rows.actionEn: Avoid travel on mountain roads. Use designated alternative routes. Do not attempt to clear debris yourself. Report blockages to road authorities.
rows.actionSw: Epuka safari kwenye barabara za milimani. Tumia njia mbadala zilizoelekezwa. Usijaribu kuondoa uchafu mwenyewe. Toa taarifa za vizuizi kwa mamlaka za barabara.

rows.impactEn: Risk of injuries from falling debris and collapsing slopes
rows.impactSw: Hatari ya majeraha kutokana na uchafu unaoanguka na miteremko inayoporomoka
rows.actionEn: Stay away from steep slopes and cliffs. Do not enter areas marked as dangerous. Report observed slope movement immediately.
rows.actionSw: Kaa mbali na miteremko mikali na majabali. Usiingie maeneo yenye alama za hatari. Toa taarifa mara moja kuhusu mienendo ya mteremko unayoiona.

rows.impactEn: Streams becoming suddenly muddy or temporarily stopping flow (sign of upstream blockage)
rows.impactSw: Mito kubadilika ghafla kuwa na matope au kusimamisha mtiririko kwa muda (dalili ya kuziba kwa juu)
rows.actionEn: If a stream suddenly stops flowing during heavy rain, evacuate downstream areas immediately as a natural dam may have formed. If streams become unusually muddy, alert downstream communities.
rows.actionSw: Mto ukisimamisha mtiririko ghafla wakati wa mvua kubwa, hama mara moja kutoka maeneo ya chini kwani huenda bwawa la asili limeundwa. Mto ukibadilika ghafla kuwa na matope kwa kiasi kisicho cha kawaida, watahadharishe wakazi wa maeneo ya chini.

rows.impactEn: Communities being cut off as roads become impassable
rows.impactSw: Jamii kutengwa kutokana na barabara kutopitika
rows.actionEn: Stock essential supplies (water, food, medicines) for several days. Charge phones and prepare radios. Identify alternative routes on foot if possible.
rows.actionSw: Weka akiba ya mahitaji muhimu (maji, chakula, dawa) kwa siku kadhaa. Chaji simu na andaa redio. Tambua njia mbadala za kutembea kwa miguu inapowezekana.

rows.impactEn: Damage to power and communication lines from earth movement and falling trees
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu wa nyaya za umeme na mawasiliano kutokana na mienendo ya ardhi na miti kuanguka
rows.actionEn: Report fallen power lines to TANESCO. Keep distance from broken lines. Charge mobile devices and prepare radios in advance.
rows.actionSw: Toa taarifa kwa TANESCO kuhusu nyaya za umeme zilizoanguka. Weka umbali na nyaya zilizokatika. Chaji vifaa vya simu na andaa redio mapema.

rows.impactEn: Loss of farms, livestock and food crops on hillside areas
rows.impactSw: Upotevu wa mashamba, mifugo na mazao ya chakula katika maeneo ya miteremko
rows.actionEn: Move livestock and food stores away from slopes. Report agricultural damage to extension officers. Harvest mature crops where it is safe to do so.
rows.actionSw: Hamisha mifugo na akiba ya chakula mbali na miteremko. Toa taarifa ya uharibifu wa kilimo kwa maafisa ugani. Vuna mazao yaliyokomaa pale ambapo ni salama kufanya hivyo.

rows.impactEn: Damage to water sources, springs and pipes from ground movement
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu wa vyanzo vya maji, chemchemi na mabomba kutokana na mienendo ya ardhi
rows.actionEn: Treat or boil drinking water. Identify alternative water sources. Report damaged water pipes to authorities.
rows.actionSw: Tibu au chemsha maji ya kunywa. Tambua vyanzo mbadala vya maji. Toa taarifa ya mabomba ya maji yaliyoharibika kwa mamlaka.

rows.impactEn: Unusual sounds (cracking wood, rumbling, knocking rocks) indicating moving debris
rows.impactSw: Sauti zisizo za kawaida (miti kupasuka, mvumo, mawe yanayogongana) zinazoonyesha uchafu unaosogea
rows.actionEn: If you hear unusual rumbling or cracking, evacuate immediately to the side of the slope (not up or down). Warn neighbours. Contact local authorities.
rows.actionSw: Ukisikia mvumo au sauti za kupasuka zisizo za kawaida, hama mara moja kuelekea kando ya mteremko (si juu wala chini). Watahadharishe majirani. Wasiliana na mamlaka za eneo.

rows.impactEn: Possible school closures and disruption of services in affected areas
rows.impactSw: Uwezekano wa kufungwa kwa shule na kuvurugika kwa huduma katika maeneo yaliyoathirika
rows.actionEn: Follow education authority directives. Arrange temporary studies at home. Identify safe routes for children if school remains open.
rows.actionSw: Fuata maelekezo ya mamlaka za elimu. Panga masomo ya muda nyumbani. Tambua njia salama kwa watoto endapo shule itaendelea kufunguliwa.

rows.impactEn: Massive slope failures and channelized debris flows of mud, stones and trees
rows.impactSw: Maporomoko makubwa ya miteremko na mtiririko wa matope, mawe na miti kupitia mikondo
rows.actionEn: Implement community-wide evacuation immediately. Move to the side of the slope (not up or down). Use official shelters. Do not return until cleared by authorities.
rows.actionSw: Tekeleza uhamishaji wa jamii nzima mara moja. Hama kuelekea kando ya mteremko (si juu wala chini). Tumia makazi rasmi. Usirudi mpaka uthibitishwe na mamlaka.

rows.impactEn: Burial of homes, vehicles and people under mud, rocks and debris
rows.impactSw: Kufukiwa kwa nyumba, magari na watu chini ya matope, mawe na uchafu
rows.actionEn: Contact emergency services immediately for trapped persons. Coordinate rescue efforts with JWTZ and local authorities. Do not enter buried areas without trained rescuers.
rows.actionSw: Wasiliana mara moja na vyombo vya dharura kuhusu watu waliokwama. Ratibu juhudi za uokoaji na JWTZ na mamlaka za eneo. Usiingie maeneo yaliyofukiwa bila waokoaji waliofunzwa.

rows.impactEn: Multiple fatalities and people trapped under debris
rows.impactSw: Vifo vingi na watu kunaswa chini ya uchafu
rows.actionEn: Activate emergency medical services and psychosocial support. Establish triage points for the injured. Coordinate body recovery with district authorities.
rows.actionSw: Anzisha huduma za matibabu ya dharura na msaada wa kisaikolojia. Weka vituo vya kukagua majeruhi. Ratibu uokoaji wa miili na mamlaka za wilaya.

rows.impactEn: Major roads and bridges destroyed, cutting off entire communities
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu mkubwa wa barabara na madaraja, kutenganisha jamii nzima
rows.actionEn: Open alternative routes where possible. Coordinate air support for isolated communities. Clear emergency access routes for rescue teams.
rows.actionSw: Fungua njia mbadala inapowezekana. Ratibu usaidizi wa hewani kwa jamii zilizotengwa. Safisha njia za dharura kwa timu za uokoaji.

rows.impactEn: Damage to schools, health facilities and public buildings
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu wa shule, vituo vya afya na majengo ya umma
rows.actionEn: Establish temporary health and learning centres at safe locations. Coordinate medical evacuation with regional authorities. Ensure continuity of essential services.
rows.actionSw: Anzisha vituo vya muda vya afya na masomo katika maeneo salama. Ratibu uhamishaji wa wagonjwa na mamlaka za mkoa. Hakikisha huduma muhimu zinaendelea.

rows.impactEn: Blocking of rivers creating natural dams with downstream flooding risk
rows.impactSw: Kuzibwa kwa mito kunakounda mabwawa ya asili na hatari ya mafuriko maeneo ya chini
rows.actionEn: Evacuate all downstream communities immediately as natural dams may suddenly fail. Monitor blocked rivers continuously. Coordinate controlled releases with engineers if possible.
rows.actionSw: Hama mara moja kwa jamii zote za maeneo ya chini kwani mabwawa ya asili yanaweza kupasuka ghafla. Fuatilia mito iliyozibwa muda wote. Ratibu uachiaji wa maji kwa udhibiti na wahandisi inapowezekana.

rows.impactEn: Long-term displacement of thousands of households
rows.impactSw: Uhamishaji wa muda mrefu wa maelfu ya kaya
rows.actionEn: Establish official mass shelters. Coordinate long-term resettlement plans with district authorities. Provide food, water and protection for displaced families.
rows.actionSw: Anzisha makazi rasmi ya pamoja. Ratibu mipango ya makazi ya kudumu na mamlaka za wilaya. Toa chakula, maji na ulinzi kwa kaya zilizohama.

rows.impactEn: Severe contamination of water sources by mud, debris and lost materials
rows.impactSw: Uchafuzi mkubwa wa vyanzo vya maji kutokana na matope, uchafu na vifaa vilivyopotea
rows.actionEn: Distribute safe drinking water. Test affected streams and wells before reuse. Use ORS for diarrhoea. Ensure water-treatment supplies reach affected communities.
rows.actionSw: Sambaza maji salama ya kunywa. Pima mito na visima vilivyoathirika kabla ya kutumia tena. Tumia ORS kwa kuhara. Hakikisha vifaa vya kutibu maji vinafika kwa jamii zilizoathirika.

rows.impactEn: Widespread loss of agricultural land, livestock and livelihoods
rows.impactSw: Upotevu mkubwa wa eneo la kilimo, mifugo na vyanzo vya mapato
rows.actionEn: Coordinate emergency food and cash assistance. Develop recovery programmes with agricultural extension services. Provide reconstruction support for affected farms.
rows.actionSw: Ratibu msaada wa dharura wa chakula na fedha. Tengeneza programu za urejeshaji na maafisa ugani wa kilimo. Toa msaada wa ujenzi upya kwa mashamba yaliyoathirika.

rows.impactEn: Severe disruption to power and communication networks
rows.impactSw: Kuvurugika kwa kiasi kikubwa kwa mitandao ya umeme na mawasiliano
rows.actionEn: Use alternative communication (radios, satellite phones). Coordinate utility restoration with TANESCO and telecom operators. Follow official radio broadcasts.
rows.actionSw: Tumia mawasiliano mbadala (redio, simu za satelaiti). Ratibu urejeshaji wa huduma na TANESCO na watoa huduma za mawasiliano. Fuatilia matangazo rasmi ya redio.

rows.impactEn: Long-term disruption of livelihoods and social services
rows.impactSw: Kuvurugika kwa muda mrefu kwa vyanzo vya mapato na huduma za kijamii
rows.actionEn: Develop long-term recovery and reconstruction programmes. Provide reconstruction grants to affected households. Restore essential services in stages.
rows.actionSw: Tengeneza programu za muda mrefu za urejeshaji na ujenzi upya. Toa ruzuku za ujenzi upya kwa kaya zilizoathirika. Rejesha huduma muhimu kwa hatua.

rows.impactEn: Loose objects being blown by wind in few areas
rows.impactSw: Vitu vilivyolegea kupeperushwa na upepo katika maeneo machache
rows.actionEn: Remove or secure loose items around homes (laundry, garden tools, loose roofing sheets, signs). Bring outdoor furniture indoors.
rows.actionSw: Ondoa au funga vitu vinavyoweza kupeperushwa karibu na nyumba (nguo zilizoanikwa, vifaa vya bustani, mabati yaliyolegea, mabango). Ingiza samani za nje ndani.

rows.impactEn: Difficulty walking outdoors, especially for children and the elderly
rows.impactSw: Ugumu wa kutembea nje, hasa kwa watoto na wazee
rows.actionEn: Special groups including people with disabilities, children and the elderly should be given early warning information and appropriate measures should be taken by the community concerned. Avoid unnecessary outdoor activities.
rows.actionSw: Makundi maalum ikijumuisha watu wenye ulemavu, watoto na wazee wapatiwe taarifa ya tahadhari ya mapema na hatua stahiki zichukuliwe na jamii husika. Epuka shughuli zisizo za lazima nje.

rows.impactEn: Difficulty driving large vehicles like lorries and buses on exposed roads
rows.impactSw: Ugumu wa kuendesha magari makubwa kama malori na mabasi kwenye barabara zilizo wazi
rows.actionEn: Drivers of large vehicles should drive slowly on exposed roads and bridges. Reduce speed when overtaking other vehicles.
rows.actionSw: Madereva wa magari makubwa waendeshe taratibu kwenye barabara zilizo wazi na madaraja. Punguza mwendo wakati wa kupita gari jingine.

rows.impactEn: Risk of small branches and weak roofing being blown off in few areas
rows.impactSw: Hatari ya matawi madogo na paa dhaifu kupeperushwa katika maeneo machache
rows.actionEn: Inspect and repair weak roofs before strong winds. Trim weak branches around homes. Secure loose roofing sheets.
rows.actionSw: Kagua na rekebisha paa dhaifu kabla ya upepo mkali. Kata matawi dhaifu karibu na nyumba. Imarisha mabati yaliyolegea.

rows.impactEn: Localised disruption to outdoor activities and small markets
rows.impactSw: Kuathirika kwa shughuli za nje na masoko madogo katika maeneo machache
rows.actionEn: Postpone non-essential outdoor activities and gatherings. Continue to follow weather information from the Tanzania Meteorological Authority.
rows.actionSw: Ahirisha shughuli za nje zisizo za lazima na mikusanyiko. Endelea kufuatilia taarifa za hali ya hewa zinazotolewa na Mamlaka ya Hali ya Hewa Tanzania.

rows.impactEn: Higher waves at sea posing risk to small fishing vessels
rows.impactSw: Mawimbi makubwa baharini yanayohatarisha vyombo vidogo vya uvuvi
rows.actionEn: Small craft and fishermen should remain at the coast. Coastal communities monitor sea conditions before going out.
rows.actionSw: Vyombo vidogo na wavuvi wabaki pwani. Jamii za pwani zifuatilie hali ya bahari kabla ya kwenda baharini.

rows.impactEn: Possibility of dust raised in dry areas reducing visibility
rows.impactSw: Uwezekano wa vumbi kuinuka katika maeneo makavu na kupunguza uwezo wa kuona
rows.actionEn: Drive slowly with headlights on in dusty conditions. People with respiratory conditions stay indoors.
rows.actionSw: Endesha taratibu ukiwasha taa za mbele wakati wa vumbi. Watu wenye matatizo ya kupumua wabaki ndani.

rows.impactEn: Risk of falling small branches damaging vehicles and pedestrians
rows.impactSw: Hatari ya matawi madogo kuanguka na kuharibu magari na watembea kwa miguu
rows.actionEn: Park vehicles away from trees and weak structures. Report dangerous trees near homes to local authorities.
rows.actionSw: Egesha magari mbali na miti na miundo dhaifu. Toa taarifa kwa mamlaka za eneo kuhusu miti hatarishi karibu na nyumba.

rows.impactEn: Localised damage to flowering crops, fruit trees and banana plants
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu mdogo wa mazao yanayochanua, miti ya matunda na migomba katika maeneo machache
rows.actionEn: Stake young plants and banana stems for support. Harvest mature fruits early. Secure shade nets and seedling structures.
rows.actionSw: Imarisha mimea michanga na migomba kwa miti ya kuegemea. Vuna matunda yaliyokomaa mapema. Imarisha nyavu za kivuli na vitalu vya miche.

rows.impactEn: Possibility of brief power outages from power lines being swayed by wind
rows.impactSw: Uwezekano wa kukatika kwa muda mfupi kwa umeme kutokana na nyaya kupeperushwa na upepo
rows.actionEn: Charge phones and torches in advance. Report sparking or fallen power lines to TANESCO. Keep distance from broken lines.
rows.actionSw: Chaji simu na tochi mapema. Toa taarifa kwa TANESCO kuhusu nyaya za umeme zinazotoa cheche au zilizoanguka. Weka umbali na nyaya zilizoanguka.

rows.impactEn: Many areas affected by strong winds and damaging gusts
rows.impactSw: Maeneo mengi kuathiriwa na upepo mkali na vishindo vyenye uharibifu
rows.actionEn: Stay indoors during peak winds. Identify safe rooms away from windows. Cooperate with local leaders.
rows.actionSw: Kaa ndani wakati wa upepo mkali. Tambua vyumba salama mbali na madirisha. Shirikiana na viongozi wa eneo.

rows.impactEn: Significant flying debris causing injuries and damage
rows.impactSw: Vitu vingi kupeperushwa hewani na kusababisha majeraha na uharibifu
rows.actionEn: Stay away from windows. Do not go outdoors unless necessary. Remove or secure all loose items immediately.
rows.actionSw: Kaa mbali na madirisha. Usitoke nje isipokuwa ni lazima. Ondoa au funga vitu vyote vilivyolegea mara moja.

rows.impactEn: Falling trees and large branches blocking roads and damaging power lines
rows.impactSw: Miti na matawi makubwa kuanguka na kuziba barabara na kuharibu nyaya za umeme
rows.actionEn: Avoid sheltering under trees. Report fallen trees to local authorities. Keep distance from broken power lines.
rows.actionSw: Epuka kujihifadhi chini ya miti. Toa taarifa ya miti iliyoanguka kwa mamlaka za eneo. Weka umbali na nyaya za umeme zilizokatika.

rows.impactEn: Significant damage to roofs and weak buildings
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu mkubwa wa paa na majengo dhaifu
rows.actionEn: Move out of weak or damaged buildings. Relocate to safe rooms or shelters. Report damage to local authorities.
rows.actionSw: Hama kutoka majengo dhaifu au yaliyoharibika. Hamia kwenye vyumba salama au makazi ya muda. Toa taarifa ya uharibifu kwa mamlaka za eneo.

rows.impactEn: Travel delays and disruption on roads, rail and at airports
rows.impactSw: Ucheleweshaji wa safari na kuvurugika kwenye barabara, reli na viwanja vya ndege
rows.actionEn: Avoid non-essential travel. Large vehicles avoid exposed routes. Allow extra travel time. Check with airlines for delays.
rows.actionSw: Epuka safari zisizo za lazima. Magari makubwa yaepuke barabara zilizo wazi. Weka muda wa ziada wa safari. Wasiliana na mashirika ya ndege kuhusu ucheleweshaji.

rows.impactEn: Widespread power outages from fallen lines and trees
rows.impactSw: Kukatika kwa umeme kwenye maeneo mengi kutokana na nyaya na miti kuanguka
rows.actionEn: Stock essential supplies (water, food, medicines, torches). Prepare for loss of electricity and communication. Report fallen power lines to TANESCO.
rows.actionSw: Weka akiba ya mahitaji muhimu (maji, chakula, dawa, tochi). Jiandae kukosekana kwa umeme na mawasiliano. Toa taarifa kwa TANESCO kuhusu nyaya za umeme zilizoanguka.

rows.impactEn: Disruption to communication networks (mobile towers and internet)
rows.impactSw: Kuvurugika kwa mitandao ya mawasiliano (minara ya simu na intaneti)
rows.actionEn: Charge mobile devices and prepare radios in advance. Agree on family meeting points in case of communication loss.
rows.actionSw: Chaji vifaa vya simu na andaa redio mapema. Kubaliana na familia kuhusu sehemu za kukutana endapo mawasiliano yatakatika.

rows.impactEn: High waves and dangerous sea conditions for fishermen and coastal residents
rows.impactSw: Mawimbi makubwa na hali hatari ya bahari kwa wavuvi na wakazi wa pwani
rows.actionEn: Suspend all small craft and fishing operations. Coastal residents move away from shorelines. Report missing vessels immediately.
rows.actionSw: Sitisha shughuli zote za vyombo vidogo na uvuvi. Wakazi wa pwani waondoke kando ya bahari. Toa taarifa mara moja kuhusu vyombo vilivyopotea.

rows.impactEn: Significant damage to standing crops, banana plants and fruit trees
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu mkubwa wa mazao yaliyo shambani, migomba na miti ya matunda
rows.actionEn: Harvest mature crops early where possible. Report damage to agricultural extension officers. Do not enter fields during winds.
rows.actionSw: Vuna mazao yaliyokomaa mapema inapowezekana. Toa taarifa ya uharibifu kwa maafisa ugani wa kilimo. Usiingie shambani wakati wa upepo.

rows.impactEn: Dust storms reducing visibility in dry inland areas
rows.impactSw: Dhoruba za vumbi zinazopunguza uwezo wa kuona katika maeneo makavu ya bara
rows.actionEn: Avoid travel during dust storms. Close windows and doors tightly. People with respiratory conditions wear masks indoors.
rows.actionSw: Epuka safari wakati wa dhoruba za vumbi. Funga madirisha na milango vizuri. Watu wenye matatizo ya kupumua wavae barakoa wakiwa ndani.

rows.impactEn: Closure of schools and outdoor markets in affected areas
rows.impactSw: Kufungwa kwa shule na masoko ya nje katika maeneo yaliyoathirika
rows.actionEn: Follow education authority directives. Arrange temporary studies at home. Markets relocate to sheltered locations.
rows.actionSw: Fuata maelekezo ya mamlaka za elimu. Panga masomo ya muda nyumbani. Masoko yahamie sehemu zenye kifuniko.

rows.impactEn: Risk of injuries at construction sites from loose materials and scaffolding
rows.impactSw: Hatari ya majeraha kwenye sehemu za ujenzi kutokana na vifaa vilivyolegea na skafodi
rows.actionEn: Suspend construction work during strong winds. Secure scaffolding, cranes and loose materials. Cordon off active sites.
rows.actionSw: Sitisha shughuli za ujenzi wakati wa upepo mkali. Imarisha skafodi, krani na vifaa vilivyolegea. Weka vizuizi maeneo ya ujenzi yanayoendelea.

rows.impactEn: Severe widespread strong winds affecting whole communities
rows.impactSw: Upepo mkali sana ulioenea unaoathiri jamii nzima
rows.actionEn: Stay indoors in safe rooms. Do not go outside. Community-wide evacuation from weak structures may be necessary.
rows.actionSw: Kaa ndani katika vyumba salama. Usitoke nje. Uhamishaji wa jamii nzima kutoka miundo dhaifu unaweza kuwa muhimu.

rows.impactEn: Loss of life from flying debris, collapsing structures and falling trees
rows.impactSw: Vifo kutokana na vitu vinavyopeperushwa, kuporomoka kwa miundo na miti kuanguka
rows.actionEn: Take shelter in the strongest part of a sturdy building. Stay away from windows and exterior walls. Contact emergency services for trapped persons.
rows.actionSw: Jihifadhi katika sehemu imara zaidi ya jengo madhubuti. Kaa mbali na madirisha na kuta za nje. Wasiliana na vyombo vya dharura kuhusu watu waliokwama.

rows.impactEn: Severe damage and collapse of buildings, especially weak structures and traditional roofs
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu mkubwa na kuporomoka kwa majengo, hususani miundo dhaifu na paa za asili
rows.actionEn: Evacuate all weak or damaged buildings immediately. Relocate to designated official shelters. Do not return until cleared by authorities.
rows.actionSw: Hama mara moja kutoka majengo yote dhaifu au yaliyoharibika. Hamia kwenye makazi rasmi yaliyoteuliwa. Usirudi mpaka uthibitishwe na mamlaka.

rows.impactEn: Major widespread power outages lasting many days
rows.impactSw: Kukatika kwa umeme kwa kiasi kikubwa katika maeneo mengi kwa siku nyingi
rows.actionEn: Prepare for loss of services for several days. Establish community resource centres (water, information, health). Use generators outdoors only to avoid carbon monoxide poisoning.
rows.actionSw: Jiandae kukosa huduma kwa siku kadhaa. Weka vituo vya rasilimali vya jamii (maji, taarifa, afya). Tumia jenereta nje tu ili kuepuka sumu ya gesi ya monoksaidi ya kaboni.

rows.impactEn: Major disruption to all forms of transport (road, rail, air, marine)
rows.impactSw: Kuvurugika kwa kiasi kikubwa kwa aina zote za usafiri (barabara, reli, anga, baharini)
rows.actionEn: Stay home if possible. Do not travel. Keep emergency routes clear. Follow official directives from transport authorities.
rows.actionSw: Kaa nyumbani ikiwezekana. Usisafiri. Ziache wazi njia za dharura. Fuata maelekezo rasmi kutoka mamlaka za usafiri.

rows.impactEn: Severe damage to coastal infrastructure, ports and fishing communities
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu mkubwa wa miundombinu ya pwani, bandari na jamii za uvuvi
rows.actionEn: All marine activities suspended. Coastal residents evacuate to higher ground. Fishermen at sea seek nearest safe harbour immediately.
rows.actionSw: Sitisha shughuli zote za baharini. Wakazi wa pwani wahame kwenda maeneo ya juu. Wavuvi waliopo baharini watafute bandari salama iliyo karibu mara moja.

rows.impactEn: Severe damage to crops, livestock and food stores
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu mkubwa wa mazao, mifugo na akiba ya chakula
rows.actionEn: Move and protect food reserves in strong storage. Secure livestock in sturdy shelters. Coordinate emergency assistance with district authorities.
rows.actionSw: Hamisha na linda akiba ya chakula katika hifadhi imara. Weka mifugo katika mabanda imara. Ratibu msaada wa dharura na mamlaka za wilaya.

rows.impactEn: Major disruption to communication networks affecting emergency response
rows.impactSw: Kuvurugika kwa kiasi kikubwa kwa mitandao ya mawasiliano kunakoathiri huduma za dharura
rows.actionEn: Use alternative communication (radios, satellite phones). Follow official radio broadcasts. Agree with family on meeting points.
rows.actionSw: Tumia mawasiliano mbadala (redio, simu za satelaiti). Fuatilia matangazo rasmi ya redio. Kubaliana na familia kuhusu sehemu za kukutana.

rows.impactEn: Large-scale evacuation of people may be required
rows.impactSw: Uhamishaji mkubwa wa watu unaweza kuhitajika
rows.actionEn: Implement evacuation plan. Register at official shelters. Assist those with special needs. Carry an emergency bag.
rows.actionSw: Tekeleza mpango wa uhamishaji. Jisajili kwenye makazi rasmi. Saidia wenye uhitaji maalum. Chukua begi la dharura.

rows.impactEn: Widespread school and business closures
rows.impactSw: Kufungwa kwa shule na biashara katika maeneo mengi
rows.actionEn: Provide remote learning options. Keep children at home. Ensure safety before reopening.
rows.actionSw: Toa chaguo za masomo ya mbali. Waweke watoto nyumbani. Hakikisha usalama kabla ya kufungua tena.

rows.impactEn: Possibility of fires being fanned by wind and spreading rapidly
rows.impactSw: Uwezekano wa moto kuchochewa na upepo na kusambaa kwa kasi
rows.actionEn: Avoid using open flames outdoors. Report any fires to authorities immediately. Keep firebreaks around buildings clear.
rows.actionSw: Epuka kutumia moto wazi nje. Toa taarifa mara moja kwa mamlaka kuhusu moto wowote. Weka maeneo ya kuzuia moto karibu na majengo wazi.

rows.impactEn: Higher waves on the ocean and lakes posing risk to small craft and canoes
rows.impactSw: Mawimbi makubwa zaidi baharini na maziwani yanayohatarisha vyombo vidogo na ngalawa
rows.actionEn: Small craft, canoes and fishermen should remain at the shore. Check weather forecasts before going out. Coastal communities monitor sea and lake conditions.
rows.actionSw: Vyombo vidogo, ngalawa na wavuvi wabaki ufukweni. Angalia taarifa za hali ya hewa kabla ya kwenda majini. Jamii za pwani zifuatilie hali ya bahari na ziwa.

rows.impactEn: Difficult conditions for night fishing operations
rows.impactSw: Hali ngumu kwa shughuli za uvuvi wa usiku
rows.actionEn: Avoid night fishing during rough conditions. If going out always wear a life jacket. Carry a phone or signal device for emergencies.
rows.actionSw: Epuka uvuvi wa usiku wakati wa hali mbaya. Ukienda majini vaa jaketi la kuokoa maisha kila wakati. Chukua simu au kifaa cha kuashiria dharura.

rows.impactEn: Reduced safety for swimming and beach activities
rows.impactSw: Usalama mdogo kwa kuogelea na shughuli za ufukweni
rows.actionEn: Avoid swimming during rough conditions. Supervise children near water. Do not leave children unattended at the lakeshore or beach.
rows.actionSw: Epuka kuogelea wakati wa hali mbaya ya maji. Wasimamie watoto karibu na maji. Usiwaache watoto bila kusimamiwa kwenye fukwe za ziwa au bahari.

rows.impactEn: Possible disruption to small ferry services and lake transport
rows.impactSw: Uwezekano wa kuvurugika kwa huduma za vivuko vidogo na usafiri wa ziwani
rows.actionEn: Check ferry schedules before travel. Allow extra time for delays. Follow announcements from ferry operators.
rows.actionSw: Angalia ratiba za vivuko kabla ya safari. Weka muda wa ziada kwa ucheleweshaji. Fuata matangazo kutoka kwa wamiliki wa vivuko.

rows.impactEn: Risk of small craft capsizing especially when overloaded
rows.impactSw: Hatari ya vyombo vidogo kupinduka hususani vinapojaa mzigo zaidi
rows.actionEn: Do not overload boats with passengers or cargo. Ensure life jackets are worn by everyone on board. Check boat condition before departure.
rows.actionSw: Usijaze boti mizigo wala abiria zaidi. Hakikisha kila aliye ndani ya chombo amevaa jaketi la kuokoa maisha. Kagua hali ya chombo kabla ya kuanza safari.

rows.impactEn: Wave run-up onto low-lying beaches and shore walkways
rows.impactSw: Mawimbi kupanda hadi fukwe za chini na njia za kando ya pwani
rows.actionEn: Stay away from low-lying coastal walkways during high waves. Do not stand on rocks or piers during rough sea. Respect lifeguard warnings.
rows.actionSw: Kaa mbali na njia za kando ya pwani zilizo chini wakati wa mawimbi makubwa. Usisimame juu ya miamba au gati wakati wa bahari yenye msukosuko. Heshimu maonyo ya walinzi wa pwani.

rows.impactEn: Some erosion of beaches and shoreline
rows.impactSw: Mmomonyoko wa baadhi ya fukwe na kingo za pwani
rows.actionEn: Report observed erosion to local authorities. Protect beachfront property where possible. Do not remove protective vegetation from beaches.
rows.actionSw: Toa taarifa ya mmomonyoko unaouona kwa mamlaka za eneo. Linda mali za pwani inapowezekana. Usiondoe mimea ya kulinda ufukwe.

rows.impactEn: Reduced visibility on the water from spray and swell
rows.impactSw: Uwezo mdogo wa kuona juu ya maji kutokana na manyunyu na mawimbi
rows.actionEn: Reduce speed when navigating. Use marine lights and signals. Stay close to other boats for mutual support.
rows.actionSw: Punguza mwendo wakati wa kuendesha chombo. Tumia taa na ishara za baharini. Kaa karibu na vyombo vingine kwa msaada wa pamoja.

rows.impactEn: Vulnerable groups (children, the elderly, inexperienced swimmers) at higher risk near water
rows.impactSw: Makundi yaliyo katika hatari (watoto, wazee, waogeleaji wasio na uzoefu) wapo katika hatari kubwa karibu na maji
rows.actionEn: Special groups including people with disabilities, children and the elderly should be given early warning information and appropriate measures should be taken by the community concerned
rows.actionSw: Makundi maalum ikijumuisha watu wenye ulemavu, watoto na wazee wapatiwe taarifa ya tahadhari ya mapema na hatua stahiki zichukuliwe na jamii husika

rows.impactEn: Possible damage to fishing nets, traps and small fishing gear
rows.impactSw: Uwezekano wa kuharibika kwa nyavu za uvuvi, mitego na vifaa vidogo vya uvuvi
rows.actionEn: Bring fishing nets and gear inland during rough conditions. Secure stored equipment above expected wave reach. Report damage to Beach Management Units (BMU).
rows.actionSw: Leta nyavu na vifaa vya uvuvi nchi kavu wakati wa hali mbaya. Imarisha vifaa vilivyohifadhiwa juu ya kufikiwa na mawimbi. Toa taarifa ya uharibifu kwa Vikundi vya Usimamizi wa Pwani (BMU).

rows.impactEn: Many fishermen and small craft at serious risk of capsizing
rows.impactSw: Wavuvi wengi na vyombo vidogo katika hatari kubwa ya kupinduka
rows.actionEn: Suspend all small craft and night fishing operations. Ensure everyone on board wears a life jacket. Cooperate with Beach Management Units (BMU) and local leaders.
rows.actionSw: Sitisha shughuli zote za vyombo vidogo na uvuvi wa usiku. Hakikisha kila aliye ndani ya chombo amevaa jaketi la kuokoa maisha. Shirikiana na Vikundi vya Usimamizi wa Pwani (BMU) na viongozi wa eneo.

rows.impactEn: Threat to life from drowning, especially during night fishing
rows.impactSw: Hatari ya maisha kutokana na kuzama, hususani wakati wa uvuvi wa usiku
rows.actionEn: Do not go out on the water. If already at sea or on the lake, return to the nearest safe shore immediately. Report missing fishermen to local authorities and BMU.
rows.actionSw: Usitoke majini. Ukiwa tayari baharini au ziwani, rudi kwenye ufukwe salama ulio karibu mara moja. Toa taarifa ya wavuvi waliopotea kwa mamlaka za eneo na BMU.

rows.impactEn: Significant disruption to ferry services and marine transport
rows.impactSw: Kuvurugika kwa kiasi kikubwa kwa huduma za vivuko na usafiri wa baharini
rows.actionEn: Avoid non-essential travel by ferry. Follow announcements from ferry operators and TASAC. Consider alternative road routes where possible.
rows.actionSw: Epuka safari zisizo za lazima kwa vivuko. Fuata matangazo kutoka kwa wamiliki wa vivuko na TASAC. Fikiria njia mbadala za barabara inapowezekana.

rows.impactEn: Damage to small jetties, piers and beach structures
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu wa magati madogo, vituo vya mashua na miundo ya ufukweni
rows.actionEn: Move boats to higher ground or sheltered moorings. Secure beach equipment and infrastructure. Report damage to port authorities.
rows.actionSw: Hamisha boti kwenye maeneo ya juu au sehemu za hifadhi. Imarisha vifaa na miundombinu ya ufukweni. Toa taarifa ya uharibifu kwa mamlaka za bandari.

rows.impactEn: Significant beach and coastal erosion
rows.impactSw: Mmomonyoko mkubwa wa fukwe na pwani
rows.actionEn: Stay away from cliff edges and unstable beaches. Report observed erosion to local authorities. Do not build close to the changing shoreline.
rows.actionSw: Kaa mbali na kando ya majabali na fukwe zisizo imara. Toa taarifa ya mmomonyoko unaouona kwa mamlaka za eneo. Usijenge karibu na kingo za pwani zinazobadilika.

rows.impactEn: Wave overtopping of seawalls and flooding of low-lying coastal roads
rows.impactSw: Mawimbi kupita juu ya kuta za kuzuia maji na kuathiri barabara za chini za pwani
rows.actionEn: Avoid coastal roads during high waves and high tide. Do not drive through water-covered roads. Relocate from low-lying coastal homes.
rows.actionSw: Epuka barabara za pwani wakati wa mawimbi makubwa na maji ya juu. Usiendeshe gari kwenye barabara zilizofunikwa na maji. Hama kutoka nyumba za chini za pwani.

rows.impactEn: Damage to coastal hotels, tourism infrastructure and beach businesses
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu wa hoteli za pwani, miundombinu ya utalii na biashara za ufukweni
rows.actionEn: Move tourists and guests away from the shoreline. Secure outdoor furniture and equipment. Coordinate with tourism authorities for guest safety.
rows.actionSw: Wahamishe watalii na wageni mbali na ukingo wa pwani. Imarisha samani na vifaa vya nje. Shirikiana na mamlaka za utalii kwa usalama wa wageni.

rows.impactEn: Loss of fishing nets, traps and equipment
rows.impactSw: Upotevu wa nyavu, mitego na vifaa vya uvuvi
rows.actionEn: Bring fishing nets and gear well above the expected wave reach. Do not attempt to recover nets during dangerous conditions. Report losses to Beach Management Units (BMU).
rows.actionSw: Leta nyavu na vifaa vya uvuvi mbali juu ya kufikiwa na mawimbi. Usijaribu kuokoa nyavu wakati wa hali ya hatari. Toa taarifa ya upotevu kwa Vikundi vya Usimamizi wa Pwani (BMU).

rows.impactEn: Possible flooding of low-lying coastal and lakeshore communities
rows.impactSw: Uwezekano wa mafuriko katika jamii za chini za pwani na kando ya ziwa
rows.actionEn: Identify safe higher-ground areas. Relocate at-risk households if needed. Cooperate with local leaders and disaster committees.
rows.actionSw: Tambua maeneo salama ya juu. Wahamishe kaya zilizo hatarini ikihitajika. Shirikiana na viongozi wa eneo na kamati za maafa.

rows.impactEn: Possible damage to lakeside settlements from rising water
rows.impactSw: Uwezekano wa uharibifu wa makazi ya kando ya ziwa kutokana na maji yanayopanda
rows.actionEn: Move belongings to higher floors. Charge phones and prepare radios. Identify evacuation routes to higher ground.
rows.actionSw: Hamisha vitu kwenye sakafu za juu. Chaji simu na andaa redio. Tambua njia za uhamishaji kwenda maeneo ya juu.

rows.impactEn: Closure of schools in coastal and lakeshore areas
rows.impactSw: Kufungwa kwa shule katika maeneo ya pwani na kando ya ziwa
rows.actionEn: Follow education authority directives. Arrange temporary studies at home. Identify safe routes for children if school remains open.
rows.actionSw: Fuata maelekezo ya mamlaka za elimu. Panga masomo ya muda nyumbani. Tambua njia salama kwa watoto endapo shule itaendelea kufunguliwa.

rows.impactEn: Severe widespread risk to life from drowning and capsizing of vessels
rows.impactSw: Hatari kubwa iliyoenea ya maisha kutokana na kuzama na vyombo kupinduka
rows.actionEn: Suspend all marine activities (fishing, transport, tourism) immediately. Do not enter the water for any reason. Coordinate emergency response with marine authorities.
rows.actionSw: Sitisha shughuli zote za baharini na ziwani (uvuvi, usafiri, utalii) mara moja. Usiingie majini kwa sababu yoyote. Ratibu huduma za dharura na mamlaka za baharini.

rows.impactEn: Major loss of life expected in fishing communities without immediate action
rows.impactSw: Vifo vingi vinavyotegemewa katika jamii za uvuvi pasipo hatua za haraka
rows.actionEn: Recall all fishermen at sea or on the lake immediately. Coordinate rescue with Marine Police, KMKM and JWTZ Marine. Broadcast urgent warnings via radio and BMUs.
rows.actionSw: Warejeshe wavuvi wote walio baharini au ziwani mara moja. Ratibu uokoaji na Polisi wa Baharini, KMKM na kitengo cha baharini cha Jeshi la Wananchi wa Tanzania (JWTZ). Tangaza maonyo ya dharura kupitia redio na BMU.

rows.impactEn: Storm surge inundating coastal communities (Indian Ocean coast)
rows.impactSw: Mafuriko ya bahari yanayofunika jamii za pwani (pwani ya Bahari ya Hindi)
rows.actionEn: Evacuate all low-lying coastal communities immediately to higher ground. Do not return until cleared by authorities. Coordinate emergency shelters in higher areas.
rows.actionSw: Hamisha mara moja jamii zote za chini za pwani kwenda maeneo ya juu. Usirudi mpaka uthibitishwe na mamlaka. Ratibu makazi ya dharura katika maeneo ya juu.

rows.impactEn: Major damage to ports, harbours and ferry terminals
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu mkubwa wa bandari, gati na vituo vya vivuko
rows.actionEn: Suspend all port operations. Secure vessels in safe harbours where possible. Coordinate with Tanzania Ports Authority for damage assessment and recovery.
rows.actionSw: Sitisha shughuli zote za bandari. Imarisha vyombo katika bandari salama inapowezekana. Shirikiana na Mamlaka ya Bandari Tanzania kwa tathmini ya uharibifu na urejeshaji.

rows.impactEn: Severe coastal erosion and loss of land
rows.impactSw: Mmomonyoko mkubwa wa pwani na upotevu wa ardhi
rows.actionEn: Evacuate properties at the cliff edge or eroding shoreline. Do not return to undermined buildings. Coordinate long-term coastal protection with engineers.
rows.actionSw: Hama mali zilizo kando ya majabali au kingo za pwani zinazomomonyoka. Usirudi katika majengo yaliyodhoofishwa misingi. Ratibu ulinzi wa muda mrefu wa pwani na wahandisi.

rows.impactEn: Saltwater contamination of coastal wells, springs and farmland
rows.impactSw: Uchafuzi wa maji ya chumvi katika visima, chemchemi na mashamba ya pwani
rows.actionEn: Distribute safe drinking water. Test wells and springs before reuse. Flush salt-affected farmland with fresh water where possible.
rows.actionSw: Sambaza maji salama ya kunywa. Pima visima na chemchemi kabla ya kutumia tena. Safisha mashamba yaliyoathiriwa na chumvi kwa maji safi inapowezekana.

rows.impactEn: Major damage to lakeside settlements and flooding of shoreline communities
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu mkubwa wa makazi ya kando ya ziwa na mafuriko ya jamii za kingo
rows.actionEn: Implement community-wide evacuation from lakeshore areas. Use official shelters on higher ground. Assist those with special needs.
rows.actionSw: Tekeleza uhamishaji wa jamii nzima kutoka maeneo ya kando ya ziwa. Tumia makazi rasmi katika maeneo ya juu. Saidia wenye uhitaji maalum.

rows.impactEn: Severe damage to mangroves, coral reefs and coastal ecosystems
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu mkubwa wa mikoko, miamba ya matumbawe na mazingira ya pwani
rows.actionEn: Avoid disturbing damaged ecosystems. Report to environmental authorities for assessment. Coordinate restoration efforts with conservation agencies.
rows.actionSw: Epuka kusumbua mazingira yaliyoharibika. Toa taarifa kwa mamlaka za mazingira kwa tathmini. Ratibu juhudi za urejeshaji na mashirika ya hifadhi.

rows.impactEn: Long-term economic disruption to fishing and tourism livelihoods
rows.impactSw: Kuvurugika kwa muda mrefu kwa vyanzo vya mapato vya uvuvi na utalii
rows.actionEn: Coordinate emergency cash and food assistance for affected households. Develop recovery programmes with district authorities. Provide grants to replace fishing gear and small businesses.
rows.actionSw: Ratibu msaada wa dharura wa fedha na chakula kwa kaya zilizoathirika. Tengeneza programu za urejeshaji na mamlaka za wilaya. Toa ruzuku za kubadilisha vifaa vya uvuvi na biashara ndogo.

rows.impactEn: Mass evacuation of coastal and lakeshore populations may be required
rows.impactSw: Uhamishaji mkubwa wa wakazi wa pwani na kando ya ziwa unaweza kuhitajika
rows.actionEn: Implement evacuation plan. Register at official shelters. Provide food, water and protection for displaced families. Assist those with special needs.
rows.actionSw: Tekeleza mpango wa uhamishaji. Jisajili kwenye makazi rasmi. Toa chakula, maji na ulinzi kwa kaya zilizohama. Saidia wenye uhitaji maalum.

rows.impactEn: Severe disruption to coastal infrastructure (roads, power, communication)
rows.impactSw: Kuvurugika kwa kiasi kikubwa kwa miundombinu ya pwani (barabara, umeme, mawasiliano)
rows.actionEn: Use alternative communication (radios, satellite phones). Coordinate utility restoration with TANESCO and telecom operators. Clear emergency access routes.
rows.actionSw: Tumia mawasiliano mbadala (redio, simu za satelaiti). Ratibu urejeshaji wa huduma na TANESCO na watoa huduma za mawasiliano. Safisha njia za dharura.

rows.impactEn: Dry conditions and high fire risk in grasslands, savanna and forest areas
rows.impactSw: Hali ya ukame na hatari kubwa ya moto katika maeneo ya nyasi, savana na misitu
rows.actionEn: Avoid open burning and lighting fires outdoors. Report any unattended fires to local authorities. Continue to follow weather and fire information from the Tanzania Meteorological Authority.
rows.actionSw: Epuka kuchoma kwa wazi na kuwasha moto nje. Toa taarifa kwa mamlaka za eneo kuhusu moto wowote ambao haujasimamiwa. Endelea kufuatilia taarifa za hali ya hewa na moto zinazotolewa na Mamlaka ya Hali ya Hewa Tanzania.

rows.impactEn: Possibility of small fires igniting from cooking, cigarettes or unattended charcoal kilns
rows.impactSw: Uwezekano wa moto mdogo kuwaka kutokana na kupika, sigara au matanuru ya mkaa yasiyosimamiwa
rows.actionEn: Extinguish cooking fires fully before leaving the area. Do not throw cigarettes on dry vegetation. Supervise charcoal kilns at all times. Create firebreaks around charcoal-making sites.
rows.actionSw: Zima moto wa kupikia kabisa kabla ya kuondoka eneo. Usitupe sigara kwenye uoto mkavu. Simamia matanuru ya mkaa kila wakati. Tengeneza vizuizi vya moto kuzunguka maeneo ya kutengeneza mkaa.

rows.impactEn: Smoke from local fires affecting nearby air quality
rows.impactSw: Moshi kutoka kwa moto wa eneo kuathiri ubora wa hewa karibu
rows.actionEn: Close doors and windows during heavy smoke. People with asthma or breathing problems stay indoors. Use a damp cloth or N95 mask if going outside is necessary.
rows.actionSw: Funga milango na madirisha wakati wa moshi mzito. Watu wenye pumu au matatizo ya kupumua wabaki ndani. Tumia kitambaa kibichi au barakoa ya N95 ikiwa ni lazima kutoka nje.

rows.impactEn: Localised damage to vegetation, pastures and small farms from uncontrolled burning
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu mdogo wa uoto, malisho na mashamba madogo katika maeneo machache kutokana na kuchoma bila kudhibitiwa
rows.actionEn: Create firebreaks around farms, homes and grain stores. Clear dry grass from around buildings. Report damaged farms to agricultural extension officers.
rows.actionSw: Tengeneza vizuizi vya moto kuzunguka mashamba, nyumba na ghala za nafaka. Safisha nyasi kavu kuzunguka majengo. Toa taarifa kwa maafisa ugani wa kilimo kuhusu mashamba yaliyoharibika.

rows.impactEn: Possible minor disruption to roads from smoke reducing visibility
rows.impactSw: Uwezekano wa kuvurugika kidogo kwa shughuli za barabarani kutokana na moshi kupunguza uwezo wa kuona
rows.actionEn: Drive slowly with headlights on in smoky conditions. Avoid stopping on smoky roads. Report dangerous smoke conditions to road authorities.
rows.actionSw: Endesha taratibu ukiwasha taa za mbele wakati wa moshi. Epuka kusimama kwenye barabara zenye moshi. Toa taarifa kwa mamlaka za barabara kuhusu hali hatari ya moshi.

rows.impactEn: Risk to grazing livestock from smoke and small burns
rows.impactSw: Hatari kwa mifugo inayolisha kutokana na moshi na majeraha madogo ya moto
rows.actionEn: Move livestock away from areas with active fires. Provide clean water and shade. Report injured animals to livestock extension officers.
rows.actionSw: Hamisha mifugo mbali na maeneo yenye moto unaowaka. Toa maji safi na kivuli. Toa taarifa kwa maafisa ugani wa mifugo kuhusu wanyama waliojeruhiwa.

rows.impactEn: Vulnerable groups (children, the elderly, those with asthma) at higher risk from smoke
rows.impactSw: Makundi yaliyo katika hatari (watoto, wazee, wenye pumu) wapo katika hatari kubwa kutokana na moshi
rows.actionEn: Special groups including people with disabilities, children and the elderly should be given early warning information and appropriate measures should be taken by the community concerned
rows.actionSw: Makundi maalum ikijumuisha watu wenye ulemavu, watoto na wazee wapatiwe taarifa ya tahadhari ya mapema na hatua stahiki zichukuliwe na jamii husika

rows.impactEn: Risk from honey-gathering fires and beekeeping operations near forests
rows.impactSw: Hatari kutokana na moto wa kuvua asali na shughuli za ufugaji nyuki karibu na misitu
rows.actionEn: Honey gatherers should fully extinguish smoke devices before leaving. Avoid lighting fires near forest reserves. Coordinate beekeeping with forest authorities (TFS).
rows.actionSw: Wavua asali wazime kabisa vifaa vya moshi kabla ya kuondoka. Epuka kuwasha moto karibu na hifadhi za misitu. Ratibu ufugaji nyuki na mamlaka za misitu (Wakala wa Misitu Tanzania - TFS).

rows.impactEn: Risk to porters, rangers and outdoor workers in protected areas
rows.impactSw: Hatari kwa wabeba mizigo, walinzi wa hifadhi na wafanyakazi wa nje katika maeneo ya hifadhi
rows.actionEn: Workers in fire-prone areas should carry water and basic firefighting tools. Report any fires to TANAPA or TFS immediately. Do not light fires in protected areas.
rows.actionSw: Wafanyakazi wa maeneo yenye hatari ya moto wabebe maji na vifaa vya msingi vya kuzima moto. Toa taarifa mara moja kwa Mamlaka ya Hifadhi za Taifa Tanzania (TANAPA) au Wakala wa Misitu Tanzania (TFS) kuhusu moto wowote. Usiwashe moto katika maeneo ya hifadhi.

rows.impactEn: Increased workload for local fire response units and forest officers
rows.impactSw: Kuongezeka kwa kazi kwa vikosi vya zima moto vya eneo na maafisa wa misitu
rows.actionEn: Inspect firefighting tools and equipment. Pre-position water sources and equipment near high-risk areas. Coordinate with district authorities and TFS.
rows.actionSw: Kagua vifaa vya kuzima moto. Weka maji na vifaa karibu na maeneo yenye hatari kubwa. Ratibu na mamlaka za wilaya na Wakala wa Misitu Tanzania (TFS).

rows.impactEn: Widespread fires in dry vegetation and forest areas
rows.impactSw: Moto kuenea katika maeneo mengi yenye uoto mkavu na misitu
rows.actionEn: Identify safe areas and evacuation routes. Relocate at-risk households to safe locations. Cooperate with local leaders and disaster committees.
rows.actionSw: Tambua maeneo salama na njia za uhamishaji. Wahamishe kaya zilizo hatarini kwenda maeneo salama. Shirikiana na viongozi wa eneo na kamati za maafa.

rows.impactEn: Threat to homes, farms and structures near fire fronts
rows.impactSw: Hatari kwa nyumba, mashamba na miundo iliyokaribu na moto
rows.actionEn: Move valuables and documents away from threatened areas. Clear dry vegetation around buildings to create firebreaks. Have water and basic firefighting tools ready.
rows.actionSw: Hamisha vitu vya thamani na nyaraka mbali na maeneo yaliyo hatarini. Safisha uoto mkavu kuzunguka majengo ili kutengeneza vizuizi vya moto. Weka maji na vifaa vya msingi vya kuzima moto tayari.

rows.impactEn: Significant smoke and poor air quality affecting many communities
rows.impactSw: Moshi mwingi na ubora mbaya wa hewa kuathiri jamii nyingi
rows.actionEn: Stay indoors with doors and windows closed. Use N95 masks if going outdoors is necessary. People with respiratory or heart conditions seek medical advice. Close school playgrounds in heavy smoke.
rows.actionSw: Kaa ndani na milango na madirisha vifungwe. Tumia barakoa ya N95 ikiwa ni lazima kwenda nje. Watu wenye matatizo ya kupumua au moyo watafute ushauri wa kitabibu. Funga viwanja vya michezo vya shule wakati wa moshi mzito.

rows.impactEn: Damage to crops, banana plantations and standing harvests
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu wa mazao, mashamba ya migomba na mavuno yaliyo shambani
rows.actionEn: Harvest mature crops where it is safe to do so. Create firebreaks around farms. Report damage to agricultural extension officers. Move stored grain to safer locations.
rows.actionSw: Vuna mazao yaliyokomaa pale ambapo ni salama kufanya hivyo. Tengeneza vizuizi vya moto kuzunguka mashamba. Toa taarifa ya uharibifu kwa maafisa ugani wa kilimo. Hamisha nafaka iliyohifadhiwa kwenda maeneo salama zaidi.

rows.impactEn: Power outages from fires affecting power lines and poles
rows.impactSw: Kukatika kwa umeme kutokana na moto kuathiri nyaya na nguzo za umeme
rows.actionEn: Stock essential supplies (water, food, medicines, torches). Charge phones and prepare radios. Report fallen or damaged power lines to TANESCO immediately. Keep distance from broken lines.
rows.actionSw: Weka akiba ya mahitaji muhimu (maji, chakula, dawa, tochi). Chaji simu na andaa redio. Toa taarifa mara moja kwa TANESCO kuhusu nyaya za umeme zilizoanguka au kuharibika. Weka umbali na nyaya zilizokatika.

rows.impactEn: Closure of roads and disruption to travel from smoke and active fires
rows.impactSw: Kufungwa kwa barabara na kuvurugika kwa safari kutokana na moshi na moto unaoendelea
rows.actionEn: Avoid non-essential travel near fire areas. Use designated alternative routes. Do not drive through burning vegetation or heavy smoke. Follow traffic announcements.
rows.actionSw: Epuka safari zisizo za lazima karibu na maeneo ya moto. Tumia njia mbadala zilizoelekezwa. Usiendeshe gari katika uoto unaowaka au moshi mzito. Fuata matangazo ya trafiki.

rows.impactEn: Loss of livestock and displacement of wildlife from protected areas
rows.impactSw: Upotevu wa mifugo na kuhama kwa wanyamapori kutoka maeneo ya hifadhi
rows.actionEn: Move livestock to safe pastures away from fire fronts. Report missing livestock to local authorities. Ro not approach displaced wildlife. Report wildlife near homes to TANAPA or TAWA.
rows.actionSw: Hamisha mifugo kwenye malisho salama mbali na moto. Toa taarifa ya mifugo iliyopotea kwa mamlaka za eneo. Usikaribie wanyamapori waliohama. Toa taarifa kwa TANAPA au Mamlaka ya Usimamizi wa Wanyamapori Tanzania (TAWA) kuhusu wanyamapori karibu na nyumba.

rows.impactEn: Risk to firefighters, rangers and volunteer responders
rows.impactSw: Hatari kwa wazima moto, walinzi wa hifadhi na wajitolea wa kukabiliana na moto
rows.actionEn: Provide firefighters with personal protective equipment (PPE), water and rest periods. Ro not send untrained civilians to fight fires. Roordinate response with TFS, TANAPA and JWTZ.
rows.actionSw: Wapatie wazima moto vifaa vya kujikinga (PPE), maji na muda wa kupumzika. Usitume raia wasio na mafunzo kwenda kuzima moto. Ratibu juhudi na Wakala wa Misitu Tanzania (TFS), TANAPA na Jeshi la Wananchi wa Tanzania (JWTZ).

rows.impactEn: Disruption to tourism operations on Mount Kilimanjaro and in national parks
rows.impactSw: Kuvurugika kwa shughuli za utalii katika Mlima Kilimanjaro na hifadhi za taifa
rows.actionEn: Suspend climbing and safari operations in affected areas. Rvacuate tourists from threatened camps and routes. Coordinate guest safety with TANAPA and tour operators.
rows.actionSw: Sitisha shughuli za kupanda mlima na utalii katika maeneo yaliyoathirika. Wahamishe watalii kutoka kambi na njia zilizo hatarini. Ratibu usalama wa wageni na TANAPA na waendeshaji wa utalii.

rows.impactEn: Damage to communication infrastructure (mobile towers near forests)
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu wa miundombinu ya mawasiliano (minara ya simu karibu na misitu)
rows.actionEn: Charge mobile devices and prepare radios in advance. Agree on family meeting points in case of communication loss. Identify alternative communication channels.
rows.actionSw: Chaji vifaa vya simu na andaa redio mapema. Kubaliana na familia kuhusu sehemu za kukutana endapo mawasiliano yatakatika. Tambua njia mbadala za mawasiliano.

rows.impactEn: Possible school closures in heavy smoke areas
rows.impactSw: Uwezekano wa kufungwa kwa shule katika maeneo yenye moshi mzito
rows.actionEn: Follow education authority directives. Arrange temporary studies at home. Keep children indoors away from smoke. Ensure schools have N95 masks and clean-air rooms.
rows.actionSw: Fuata maelekezo ya mamlaka za elimu. Panga masomo ya muda nyumbani. Waweke watoto ndani mbali na moshi. Hakikisha shule zina barakoa za N95 na vyumba vyenye hewa safi.

rows.impactEn: Severe widespread fires threatening residential areas, forests and protected areas
rows.impactSw: Moto mkubwa ulioenea unaohatarisha maeneo ya makazi, misitu na hifadhi
rows.actionEn: Implement community-wide evacuation immediately. Move to designated official shelters in safe areas. Do not attempt to save property at the cost of life.
rows.actionSw: Tekeleza uhamishaji wa jamii nzima mara moja. Hamia kwenye makazi rasmi yaliyoteuliwa katika maeneo salama. Usijaribu kuokoa mali kwa gharama ya maisha.

rows.impactEn: Loss of life expected from fire entrapment, smoke inhalation and burns
rows.impactSw: Vifo vinavyotegemewa kutokana na kunaswa katika moto, kuvuta moshi na majeraha ya kuchomeka
rows.actionEn: Activate emergency medical services (burn care, oxygen support). Establish triage points for injured persons. Coordinate medical evacuation with regional hospitals.
rows.actionSw: Anzisha huduma za matibabu ya dharura (matibabu ya kuchomeka, msaada wa hewa ya oksijeni). Weka vituo vya kukagua majeruhi. Ratibu uhamishaji wa wagonjwa na hospitali za mkoa.

rows.impactEn: Mass evacuation of communities in high-risk zones
rows.impactSw: Uhamishaji mkubwa wa jamii katika maeneo yenye hatari kubwa
rows.actionEn: Implement evacuation plan. Register at official shelters. Provide food, water and protection for displaced families. Assist those with special needs.
rows.actionSw: Tekeleza mpango wa uhamishaji. Jisajili kwenye makazi rasmi. Toa chakula, maji na ulinzi kwa kaya zilizohama. Saidia wenye uhitaji maalum.

rows.impactEn: Major loss of crops, farms, livestock and food stores
rows.impactSw: Upotevu mkubwa wa mazao, mashamba, mifugo na akiba ya chakula
rows.actionEn: Coordinate emergency food and cash assistance with district authorities. Develop recovery programmes with agricultural extension officers. Provide seeds and inputs for replanting.
rows.actionSw: Ratibu msaada wa dharura wa chakula na fedha na mamlaka za wilaya. Tengeneza programu za urejeshaji na maafisa ugani wa kilimo. Toa mbegu na pembejeo kwa upandaji upya.

rows.impactEn: Severe air pollution affecting whole regions including distant towns
rows.impactSw: Uchafuzi mkubwa wa hewa unaoathiri mikoa mizima ikijumuisha miji ya mbali
rows.actionEn: Issue public health warnings via radio and TV. Distribute N95 masks to vulnerable groups. Suspend outdoor activities and sports. Activate clean-air centres at health facilities.
rows.actionSw: Toa maonyo ya afya ya umma kupitia redio na televisheni. Sambaza barakoa za N95 kwa makundi yaliyo hatarini. Sitisha shughuli za nje na michezo. Anzisha vituo vya hewa safi katika vituo vya afya.

rows.impactEn: Major destruction of forest reserves, protected areas and biodiversity
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu mkubwa wa hifadhi za misitu, maeneo ya hifadhi na bioanuwai
rows.actionEn: Coordinate national response with TANAPA, TFS, TAWA and the Ministry of Natural Resources. Protect critical habitats and water catchments. Plan post-fire restoration with conservation agencies.
rows.actionSw: Ratibu juhudi za kitaifa na TANAPA, Wakala wa Misitu Tanzania (TFS), TAWA na Wizara ya Maliasili na Utalii. Linda maeneo muhimu ya makazi ya wanyama na vyanzo vya maji. Panga urejeshaji baada ya moto na mashirika ya hifadhi.

rows.impactEn: Long-term economic disruption to tourism (Kilimanjaro, national parks)
rows.impactSw: Kuvurugika kwa muda mrefu kwa uchumi wa utalii (Kilimanjaro, hifadhi za taifa)
rows.actionEn: Suspend all tourism operations until cleared by authorities. Coordinate refunds and rebooking with tour operators. Develop recovery programmes with the tourism ministry.
rows.actionSw: Sitisha shughuli zote za utalii mpaka uthibitishwe na mamlaka. Ratibu marejesho ya fedha na upangaji upya na waendeshaji wa utalii. Tengeneza programu za urejeshaji na wizara ya utalii.

rows.impactEn: Major damage to power and communication networks
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu mkubwa wa mitandao ya umeme na mawasiliano
rows.actionEn: Use alternative communication (radios, satellite phones). Coordinate utility restoration with TANESCO and telecom operators. Follow official radio broadcasts.
rows.actionSw: Tumia mawasiliano mbadala (redio, simu za satelaiti). Ratibu urejeshaji wa huduma na TANESCO na watoa huduma za mawasiliano. Fuatilia matangazo rasmi ya redio.

rows.impactEn: Health emergencies: respiratory crises, cardiovascular events and burn casualties
rows.impactSw: Dharura za kiafya: matatizo ya kupumua, magonjwa ya moyo na waathirika wa kuchomeka
rows.actionEn: Activate hospital emergency departments and burn units. Deploy mobile health units to evacuation centres. Provide psychosocial support for survivors and families.
rows.actionSw: Anzisha vitengo vya dharura vya hospitali na vitengo vya majeraha ya moto. Tuma vitengo vya afya vinavyotembea kwenye vituo vya uhamishaji. Toa msaada wa kisaikolojia kwa walionusurika na familia.

rows.impactEn: Long-term environmental damage and delayed forest regeneration
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu wa muda mrefu wa mazingira na kuchelewa kwa urejeshaji wa misitu
rows.actionEn: Plan reforestation programmes after fires are fully extinguished. Protect burned areas from grazing and farming during regeneration. Engage NEMC and conservation agencies for monitoring.
rows.actionSw: Panga programu za upandaji upya wa miti baada ya moto kuzimwa kabisa. Linda maeneo yaliyoungua dhidi ya malisho na kilimo wakati wa urejeshaji. Shirikisha Baraza la Taifa la Hifadhi na Usimamizi wa Mazingira (NEMC) na mashirika ya hifadhi kwa ufuatiliaji.

rows.impactEn: National emergency response required: military deployment and aerial firefighting
rows.impactSw: Hatua za dharura za kitaifa zinahitajika: kupelekwa kwa jeshi na uzimaji wa moto kwa ndege
rows.actionEn: Mobilise JWTZ for firefighting and rescue operations. Deploy aerial firefighting where available. Coordinate national resources through the Disaster Management Department in the Prime Minister’s Office.
rows.actionSw: Hamasisha Jeshi la Wananchi wa Tanzania (JWTZ) kwa uzimaji wa moto na uokoaji. Tumia ndege za kuzima moto inapowezekana. Ratibu rasilimali za kitaifa kupitia Idara ya Maafa katika Ofisi ya Waziri Mkuu.

rows.impactEn: Below-normal rainfall and early signs of dry conditions in semi-arid areas
rows.impactSw: Mvua chini ya kawaida na dalili za awali za hali ya ukame katika maeneo ya nusu kame
rows.actionEn: Continue to follow seasonal rainfall outlooks from the Tanzania Meteorological Authority. Conserve water at household and community level. Review household drought preparedness plans.
rows.actionSw: Endelea kufuatilia utabiri wa msimu wa mvua kutoka Mamlaka ya Hali ya Hewa Tanzania. Tunza maji katika ngazi ya kaya na jamii. Kagua mipango ya kujiandaa na ukame ya kaya.

rows.impactEn: Falling soil moisture affecting germination of newly planted crops
rows.impactSw: Kupungua kwa unyevu wa udongo kunakoathiri kuota kwa mazao yaliyopandwa karibuni
rows.actionEn: Plant drought-tolerant varieties (sorghum, millet, cassava). Use mulch to retain soil moisture. Consult agricultural extension officers on best planting practices.
