rows.actionSw: Panda mbegu zinazostahimili ukame (mtama, uwele, muhogo). Tumia matandazo kuhifadhi unyevu wa udongo. Shauriana na maafisa ugani wa kilimo kuhusu mbinu bora za kupanda.

rows.impactEn: Some pasture loss in semi-arid grazing areas
rows.impactSw: Upotevu wa baadhi ya malisho katika maeneo ya nusu kame ya ufugaji
rows.actionEn: Identify reserve grazing areas. Reduce livestock numbers through early sales. Supplement feed with crop residues and stored fodder.
rows.actionSw: Tambua maeneo ya akiba ya malisho. Punguza idadi ya mifugo kwa kuuza mapema. Ongezea chakula kwa mabaki ya mazao na malisho yaliyohifadhiwa.

rows.impactEn: Reduced flow in rivers and small streams
rows.impactSw: Kupungua kwa mtiririko wa mito na vijito vidogo
rows.actionEn: Use water sparingly for domestic and farm needs. Report drying water sources to local authorities. Protect remaining water sources from contamination.
rows.actionSw: Tumia maji kwa uangalifu kwa matumizi ya nyumbani na shambani. Toa taarifa kwa mamlaka za eneo kuhusu vyanzo vya maji vinavyokauka. Linda vyanzo vya maji vilivyobaki dhidi ya uchafuzi.

rows.impactEn: Possible decline in water levels in small dams and ponds
rows.impactSw: Uwezekano wa kupungua kwa kiwango cha maji katika mabwawa madogo na madimbwi
rows.actionEn: Monitor dam levels and prepare for water rationing if needed. Restore boreholes and wells. Harvest rainwater from rooftops and gutters where possible.
rows.actionSw: Fuatilia kiwango cha maji ya mabwawa na jiandae kugawa maji ikihitajika. Rekebisha visima virefu na visima vya kawaida. Vuna maji ya mvua kutoka kwenye paa na mifereji inapowezekana.

rows.impactEn: Increased water demand for irrigation and livestock
rows.impactSw: Kuongezeka kwa mahitaji ya maji kwa umwagiliaji na mifugo
rows.actionEn: Use efficient irrigation methods (drip irrigation, mulching). Avoid wasteful water use. Coordinate water sharing between farmers and pastoralists. Report water disputes to local leaders.
rows.actionSw: Tumia mbinu bora za umwagiliaji (umwagiliaji wa matone, matandazo). Epuka matumizi mabaya ya maji. Ratibu ugawaji wa maji kati ya wakulima na wafugaji. Toa taarifa kwa viongozi wa eneo kuhusu migogoro ya maji.

rows.impactEn: Reduced quality of available water (muddier and more contaminated)
rows.impactSw: Kupungua kwa ubora wa maji yanayopatikana (yenye matope zaidi na yaliyochafuka zaidi)
rows.actionEn: Boil or treat drinking water. Cover stored water to prevent contamination. Report waterborne disease cases to the nearest health facility.
rows.actionSw: Chemsha au tibu maji ya kunywa. Funika maji yaliyohifadhiwa kuzuia uchafuzi. Toa taarifa kwa kituo cha afya kilicho karibu kuhusu visa vya magonjwa yanayotokana na maji.

rows.impactEn: Vulnerable groups (children, elderly, pregnant women) at higher risk from heat and water shortage
rows.impactSw: Makundi yaliyo hatarini (watoto, wazee, wajawazito) wapo katika hatari kubwa kutokana na joto na uhaba wa maji
rows.actionEn: Special groups including people with disabilities, children and the elderly should be given early warning information and appropriate measures should be taken by the community concerned
rows.actionSw: Makundi maalum ikijumuisha watu wenye ulemavu, watoto na wazee wapatiwe taarifa ya tahadhari ya mapema na hatua stahiki zichukuliwe na jamii husika

rows.impactEn: Possible early signs of livestock weight loss and weakening
rows.impactSw: Uwezekano wa dalili za awali za mifugo kupungua uzito na kudhoofika
rows.actionEn: Provide supplementary feed and clean water. Vaccinate livestock against drought-related diseases. Consult livestock extension officers. Consider early sale of weaker animals.
rows.actionSw: Toa malisho ya ziada na maji safi. Chanja mifugo dhidi ya magonjwa yanayohusiana na ukame. Shauriana na maafisa ugani wa mifugo. Fikiria kuuza wanyama dhaifu mapema.

rows.impactEn: Increased pressure on shared water sources (boreholes and wells)
rows.impactSw: Kuongezeka kwa shinikizo kwenye vyanzo vya maji yanayotumiwa kwa pamoja (visima virefu na visima)
rows.actionEn: Coordinate water-use schedules with neighbours and the community. Protect wells and boreholes from over-use. Report breakdowns to water authorities for repair.
rows.actionSw: Ratibu ratiba za matumizi ya maji na majirani na jamii. Linda visima na visima virefu dhidi ya matumizi mabaya. Toa taarifa kwa mamlaka za maji kuhusu uharibifu kwa ajili ya matengenezo.

rows.impactEn: Significant rainfall deficit affecting many regions
rows.impactSw: Upungufu mkubwa wa mvua unaoathiri mikoa mingi
rows.actionEn: Activate district drought response plans. Coordinate with regional disaster committees. Broadcast water and food saving advice through radio and community meetings.
rows.actionSw: Anzisha mipango ya wilaya ya kukabiliana na ukame. Ratibu na kamati za maafa za mkoa. Tangaza ushauri wa kuokoa maji na chakula kupitia redio na mikutano ya jamii.

rows.impactEn: Widespread crop stress and reduced harvests in affected areas
rows.impactSw: Mazao kuathirika kwa kiasi kikubwa na mavuno kupungua katika maeneo yaliyoathirika
rows.actionEn: Coordinate distribution of drought-tolerant seeds. Provide technical advice on managing remaining crops. Assess household food stocks and prepare food relief.
rows.actionSw: Ratibu ugawaji wa mbegu zinazostahimili ukame. Toa ushauri wa kitaalamu kuhusu kusimamia mazao yaliyobaki. Tathmini akiba ya chakula ya kaya na jiandae kwa msaada wa chakula.

rows.impactEn: Significant water scarcity for households and livestock
rows.impactSw: Uhaba mkubwa wa maji kwa kaya na mifugo
rows.actionEn: Begin water trucking to most affected villages. Prioritise water for drinking and household use. Ration water at boreholes and s ‘hared sources.
rows.actionSw: Anzisha kusafirisha maji kwa malori kwenda vijiji vilivyoathirika zaidi. Weka kipaumbele maji kwa ajili ya kunywa na matumizi ya nyumbani. Gawa maji kwa ratiba kwenye visima virefu na vyanzo vya pamoja.

rows.impactEn: Significant pasture loss requiring livestock movement to find grazing
rows.impactSw: Upotevu mkubwa wa malisho unaohitaji uhamishaji wa mifugo kutafuta malisho
rows.actionEn: Coordinate inter-district livestock movement permits. Designate emergency grazing corridors. Provide supplementary feed and minerals where possible.
rows.actionSw: Ratibu vibali vya kuhamisha mifugo kati ya wilaya. Weka njia maalum za malisho ya dharura. Toa malisho ya ziada na madini inapowezekana.

rows.impactEn: Significant decline in water levels in dams, reservoirs and rivers
rows.impactSw: Kupungua kwa kiasi kikubwa kwa kiwango cha maji katika mabwawa, hifadhi za maji na mito
rows.actionEn: Implement strict water-use restrictions for non-essential purposes. Prioritise water for human consumption. Coordinate with the Ministry of Water.
rows.actionSw: Tekeleza vizuizi vikali vya matumizi ya maji kwa matumizi yasiyo ya lazima. Weka kipaumbele maji kwa matumizi ya binadamu. Ratibu na Wizara ya Maji.

rows.impactEn: Possible reduction in hydropower generation and power supply
rows.impactSw: Uwezekano wa kupungua kwa uzalishaji wa umeme wa maji na ugavi wa umeme
rows.actionEn: Plan for power rationing schedules. Reduce non-essential electricity use. Consider alternative energy sources (solar, generators). Follow announcements from TANESCO.
rows.actionSw: Panga ratiba za mgawo wa umeme. Punguza matumizi ya umeme yasiyo ya lazima. Fikiria vyanzo mbadala vya nishati (jua, jenereta). Fuata matangazo kutoka TANESCO.

rows.impactEn: Rising food prices in affected markets
rows.impactSw: Kupanda kwa bei za vyakula katika masoko yaliyoathirika
rows.actionEn: Monitor market prices and report unusual rises to authorities. Protect vulnerable households from price shocks. Coordinate emergency food assistance with the Ministry of Agriculture.
rows.actionSw: Fuatilia bei za masoko na toa taarifa kwa mamlaka kuhusu kupanda kusiko kwa kawaida. Linda kaya zilizo hatarini dhidi ya mshtuko wa bei. Ratibu msaada wa dharura wa chakula na Wizara ya Kilimo.

rows.impactEn: Migration of pastoralists in search of water and pasture
rows.impactSw: Uhamiaji wa wafugaji wakitafuta maji na malisho
rows.actionEn: Coordinate with neighbouring districts on movement permits. Designate safe transit routes. Provide water points along migration routes. Mediate disputes between farmers and pastoralists.
rows.actionSw: Ratibu na wilaya jirani kuhusu vibali vya uhamiaji. Weka njia salama za kupita. Weka vituo vya maji kandokando ya njia za uhamiaji. Patanisha migogoro kati ya wakulima na wafugaji.

rows.impactEn: Increased risk of livestock disease and weakness
rows.impactSw: Hatari iliyoongezeka ya magonjwa na udhaifu wa mifugo
rows.actionEn: Coordinate veterinary services for emergency vaccinations. Encourage early sale of weak animals before further loss. Deploy mobile veterinary teams to affected areas.
rows.actionSw: Ratibu huduma za mifugo kwa chanjo za dharura. Himiza kuuza wanyama dhaifu mapema kabla ya hasara zaidi. Tuma timu za madaktari wa mifugo zinazotembea kwenye maeneo yaliyoathirika.

rows.impactEn: Increased waterborne illness from contaminated water sources
rows.impactSw: Kuongezeka kwa magonjwa yanayotokana na vyanzo vya maji yaliyochafuka
rows.actionEn: Treat all drinking water (boiling, chlorine tablets). Use ORS for diarrhoea. Report disease outbreaks to nearest health facility. Distribute water-treatment supplies to affected villages.
rows.actionSw: Tibu maji yote ya kunywa (kuchemsha, vidonge vya klorini). Tumia ORS kwa kuhara. Toa taarifa kwa kituo cha afya kilicho karibu kuhusu milipuko ya magonjwa. Sambaza vifaa vya kutibu maji kwa vijiji vilivyoathirika.

rows.impactEn: School attendance dropping as children fetch water from far away
rows.impactSw: Mahudhurio ya shule kupungua kwani watoto wanaenda kuteka maji mbali
rows.actionEn: Coordinate with education authorities to reduce school disruption. Provide water at schools where possible. Prioritise water access for households with school-going children.
rows.actionSw: Ratibu na mamlaka za elimu ili kupunguza kuvurugika kwa shule. Toa maji shuleni inapowezekana. Weka kipaumbele cha kupata maji kwa kaya zenye watoto wanaoenda shule.

rows.impactEn: Severe widespread drought affecting whole regions
rows.impactSw: Ukame mkubwa ulioenea unaoathiri mikoa mizima
rows.actionEn: Declare drought emergency through district authorities. Coordinate national response through the Disaster Management Department in the Prime Minister’s Office. Mobilise resources from regional and national levels.
rows.actionSw: Tangaza dharura ya ukame kupitia mamlaka za wilaya. Ratibu juhudi za kitaifa kupitia Idara ya Maafa katika Ofisi ya Waziri Mkuu. Hamasisha rasilimali kutoka ngazi za mkoa na taifa.

rows.impactEn: Major crop failure and food insecurity (IPC Phase 3 Crisis or higher)
rows.impactSw: Kushindwa kwa mazao kwa kiasi kikubwa na ukosefu wa usalama wa chakula (IPC Awamu ya 3 ya Mgogoro au zaidi)
rows.actionEn: Activate national food relief operations through the National Food Security Division of the Ministry of Agriculture. Distribute emergency food rations. Coordinate with WFP, TRCS and partner agencies.
rows.actionSw: Anzisha shughuli za kitaifa za msaada wa chakula kupitia Idara ya Kitaifa ya Usalama wa Chakula ya Wizara ya Kilimo. Sambaza chakula cha dharura. Ratibu na WFP, Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu Tanzania (TRCS) na mashirika washirika.

rows.impactEn: Mass livestock death and pastoralist livelihood collapse
rows.impactSw: Vifo vingi vya mifugo na kuporomoka kwa maisha ya wafugaji
rows.actionEn: Activate emergency destocking programmes (purchase of weak animals at fair prices). Deliver emergency feed and water to remaining livestock. Provide cash transfers to affected pastoralist households.
rows.actionSw: Anzisha programu za dharura za kupunguza mifugo (kununua wanyama dhaifu kwa bei nzuri). Peleka malisho na maji ya dharura kwa mifugo iliyobaki. Toa misaada ya fedha kwa kaya za wafugaji walioathirika.

rows.impactEn: Severe water shortage for drinking and household use
rows.impactSw: Uhaba mkubwa wa maji kwa kunywa na matumizi ya nyumbani
rows.actionEn: Implement emergency water trucking to all affected villages. Drill emergency boreholes. Restore broken-down water systems. Prioritise water for health facilities and schools.
rows.actionSw: Tekeleza usafirishaji wa dharura wa maji kwa malori kwenda vijiji vyote vilivyoathirika. Chimba visima virefu vya dharura. Rekebisha mifumo ya maji iliyoharibika. Weka kipaumbele maji kwa vituo vya afya na shule.

rows.impactEn: Major reduction in hydropower and rolling power outages
rows.impactSw: Kupungua kwa kiasi kikubwa kwa umeme wa maji na mgawo wa umeme
rows.actionEn: Implement national power rationing programme. Activate alternative power sources (gas, diesel, solar). Prioritise hospitals, water supply and essential services. Follow TANESCO announcements.
rows.actionSw: Tekeleza programu ya kitaifa ya mgawo wa umeme. Tumia vyanzo mbadala vya umeme (gesi, mafuta, jua). Weka kipaumbele kwa hospitali, ugavi wa maji na huduma muhimu. Fuata matangazo ya TANESCO.

rows.impactEn: Widespread food price inflation and market disruption
rows.impactSw: Kupanda kwa bei za vyakula kwa kiasi kikubwa na kuvurugika kwa masoko
rows.actionEn: Activate strategic food reserves. Coordinate emergency food imports if needed. Protect vulnerable households through cash transfers and subsidies. Monitor and prevent hoarding.
rows.actionSw: Tumia akiba za chakula za kimkakati. Ratibu uagizaji wa chakula wa dharura ikihitajika. Linda kaya zilizo hatarini kupitia misaada ya fedha na ruzuku. Fuatilia na zuia uhifadhi wa kificho.

rows.impactEn: Risk of malnutrition, especially in children under five years
rows.impactSw: Hatari ya utapiamlo, hususani kwa watoto chini ya miaka mitano
rows.actionEn: Activate emergency nutrition screening at health facilities. Distribute therapeutic food (RUTF) for severely malnourished children. Deploy mobile health teams. Provide supplementary feeding at schools.
rows.actionSw: Anzisha uchunguzi wa dharura wa lishe katika vituo vya afya. Sambaza chakula cha matibabu (RUTF) kwa watoto wenye utapiamlo mkali. Tuma timu za afya zinazotembea. Toa chakula cha ziada shuleni.

rows.impactEn: Mass migration of people in search of water and food
rows.impactSw: Uhamiaji mkubwa wa watu wakitafuta maji na chakula
rows.actionEn: Establish official reception areas with water, food and health services. Coordinate with the Ministry of Home Affairs for movement registration. Provide protection for women, children and elderly migrants.
rows.actionSw: Anzisha maeneo rasmi ya kupokea wahamiaji yenye maji, chakula na huduma za afya. Ratibu na Wizara ya Mambo ya Ndani kwa usajili wa uhamiaji. Toa ulinzi kwa wanawake, watoto na wahamiaji wazee.

rows.impactEn: Long-term economic damage to the agricultural sector
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu wa muda mrefu wa kiuchumi katika sekta ya kilimo
rows.actionEn: Develop long-term recovery and reconstruction programmes. Provide reconstruction grants to affected households. Restore irrigation systems and rainwater harvesting infrastructure.
rows.actionSw: Tengeneza programu za muda mrefu za urejeshaji na ujenzi upya. Toa ruzuku za ujenzi upya kwa kaya zilizoathirika. Rekebisha mifumo ya umwagiliaji na miundombinu ya kuvuna maji ya mvua.

rows.impactEn: Risk of human-wildlife conflict from migration into protected areas
rows.impactSw: Hatari ya migogoro kati ya watu na wanyamapori kutokana na uhamiaji kuingia maeneo ya hifadhi
rows.actionEn: Coordinate with TANAPA and TAWA on managing illegal grazing in parks. Designate buffer-zone grazing areas where appropriate. Mediate human-wildlife conflict cases.
rows.actionSw: Ratibu na TANAPA na TAWA kuhusu usimamizi wa malisho haramu katika hifadhi. Weka maeneo ya malisho ya kanda kuzunguka hifadhi inapofaa. Patanisha kesi za migogoro kati ya watu na wanyamapori.

rows.impactEn: National emergency response required: food relief, water trucking, livestock support
rows.impactSw: Hatua za dharura za kitaifa zinahitajika: msaada wa chakula, kusafirisha maji na kusaidia mifugo
rows.actionEn: Coordinate national resources through the Disaster Management Department in the Prime Minister’s Office. Engage international partners (UN, WFP, IFRC). Deploy specialised teams for nutrition, water and veterinary support.
rows.actionSw: Ratibu rasilimali za kitaifa kupitia Idara ya Maafa katika Ofisi ya Waziri Mkuu. Shirikisha washirika wa kimataifa (UN, WFP, IFRC). Tuma timu maalum za lishe, maji na huduma za mifugo.

rows.impactEn: Reports of minor tremors in known fault zones (East African Rift System)
rows.impactSw: Taarifa za mitetemeko midogo katika kanda za mipasuko (Bonde la Ufa la Afrika Mashariki)
rows.actionEn: Continue to follow earthquake and tsunami information from the Tanzania Meteorological Authority and the Geological Survey of Tanzania. Review household and workplace preparedness plans. Identify safe spots indoors (under sturdy desk, away from windows).
rows.actionSw: Endelea kufuatilia taarifa za tetemeko la ardhi na tsunami kutoka Mamlaka ya Hali ya Hewa Tanzania na Wakala wa Jiolojia Tanzania (GST). Kagua mipango ya kujiandaa nyumbani na sehemu za kazi. Tambua sehemu salama ndani ya jengo (chini ya meza imara, mbali na madirisha).

rows.impactEn: Distant tsunami threat following a large earthquake elsewhere in the Indian Ocean (several hours of warning time)
rows.impactSw: Hatari ya tsunami ya mbali kufuatia tetemeko kubwa mahali pengine katika Bahari ya Hindi (saa kadhaa za muda wa onyo)
rows.actionEn: Follow tsunami bulletins from the Indian Ocean Tsunami Warning and Mitigation System (IOTWMS). Coastal communities prepare to evacuate to higher ground. Do not go to the beach to watch the sea.
rows.actionSw: Fuatilia matangazo ya tsunami kutoka Mfumo wa Onyo na Kupunguza Athari za Tsunami katika Bahari ya Hindi (IOTWMS). Jamii za pwani zijiandae kuhama kwenda maeneo ya juu. Usiende ufukweni kuangalia bahari.

rows.impactEn: Need to review household and workplace earthquake preparedness (Drop, Cover and Hold On)
rows.impactSw: Haja ya kukagua mipango ya kujiandaa kwa tetemeko nyumbani na sehemu za kazi (Anguka, Jificha na Shikilia)
rows.actionEn: Practise Drop, Cover and Hold On drills with family and at workplace. Secure heavy furniture and shelves to walls. Prepare an emergency kit (water, food, torch, radio, first aid).
rows.actionSw: Fanya mazoezi ya kuanguka, kujificha na kushikilia pamoja na familia na sehemu za kazi. Imarisha samani nzito na rafu kwenye kuta. andaa kifurushi cha dharura (maji, chakula, tochi, redio, huduma ya kwanza).

rows.impactEn: Possible minor cracks appearing in older buildings from minor tremors
rows.impactSw: Uwezekano wa nyufa ndogo kuonekana katika majengo ya zamani kutokana na mitetemeko midogo
rows.actionEn: Inspect homes and buildings for new cracks. Report unsafe structures to local authorities. Do not occupy buildings with serious cracks until inspected by a qualified engineer.
rows.actionSw: Kagua nyumba na majengo kuangalia nyufa mpya. Toa taarifa kwa mamlaka za eneo kuhusu miundo isiyo salama. Usikae katika majengo yenye nyufa kubwa mpaka yakaguliwe na mhandisi mwenye sifa.

rows.impactEn: Need for public risk communication and dispelling of rumours about earthquake predictions
rows.impactSw: Haja ya mawasiliano ya hatari kwa umma na kuondoa uvumi kuhusu utabiri wa tetemeko
rows.actionEn: Broadcast official information through radio, TV and community meetings. Respond to questions from the public. Counter false rumours about predictions and false alarms.
rows.actionSw: Tangaza taarifa rasmi kupitia redio, televisheni na mikutano ya jamii. Jibu maswali ya umma. Pinga uvumi wa uongo kuhusu utabiri na taarifa za uongo.

rows.impactEn: Vulnerable groups need preparedness support and clear evacuation plans
rows.impactSw: Makundi yaliyo hatarini yanahitaji msaada wa kujiandaa na mipango wazi ya uhamishaji
rows.actionEn: Special groups including people with disabilities, children and the elderly should be given early warning information and appropriate measures should be taken by the community concerned
rows.actionSw: Makundi maalum ikijumuisha watu wenye ulemavu, watoto na wazee wapatiwe taarifa ya tahadhari ya mapema na hatua stahiki zichukuliwe na jamii husika

rows.impactEn: Risk of unsafe self-construction in seismic zones (no reinforcement, weak materials)
rows.impactSw: Hatari ya ujenzi binafsi usio salama katika maeneo ya tetemeko (bila kuimarishwa, vifaa dhaifu)
rows.actionEn: Use earthquake-resistant construction techniques (reinforced concrete, tied roofs, wall bracing). Consult qualified engineers for building plans in seismic zones. Follow national building codes.
rows.actionSw: Tumia mbinu za ujenzi zinazostahimili tetemeko (zege iliyoimarishwa, paa zilizofungwa, kuimarisha kuta). Shauriana na wahandisi wenye sifa kuhusu ramani za ujenzi katika maeneo ya tetemeko. Fuata kanuni za kitaifa za ujenzi.

rows.impactEn: Schools and clinics need to conduct earthquake drills
rows.impactSw: Shule na vituo vya afya zinahitaji kufanya mazoezi ya tetemeko
rows.actionEn: Schedule regular earthquake drills at schools and health facilities. Identify safe assembly points outside buildings. Train staff on first aid and emergency procedures.
rows.actionSw: Panga mazoezi ya kawaida ya tetemeko shuleni na vituo vya afya. Tambua sehemu salama za kukusanyika nje ya majengo. Toa mafunzo kwa wafanyakazi kuhusu huduma ya kwanza na taratibu za dharura.

rows.impactEn: Coastal communities need tsunami-awareness refresher and evacuation route review
rows.impactSw: Jamii za pwani zinahitaji kukumbushwa kuhusu tsunami na kukagua njia za uhamishaji
rows.actionEn: Mark and inform tsunami evacuation routes to higher ground. Teach the natural warning signs (long, strong shaking near the coast. Sudden sea drawback). Designate vertical-evacuation buildings if higher ground is far.
rows.actionSw: Weka alama na taarifu njia za uhamishaji wa tsunami kwenda maeneo ya juu. Fundisha ishara za asili za onyo (mtikisiko mrefu na mkali karibu na pwani. Bahari kurudi nyuma ghafla). Teua majengo ya uhamishaji wa juu endapo maeneo ya juu yapo mbali.

rows.impactEn: Disaster management committees need to test communication channels and response plans
rows.impactSw: Kamati za usimamizi wa maafa zinahitaji kupima njia za mawasiliano na mipango ya kukabiliana
rows.actionEn: Test radio and telephone communication chains regularly. Review earthquake and tsunami response plans at district and ward level. Ensure all committee members understand their roles.
rows.actionSw: Pima njia za mawasiliano za redio na simu mara kwa mara. Kagua mipango ya kukabiliana na tetemeko na tsunami katika ngazi za wilaya na kata. Hakikisha wajumbe wote wa kamati wanaelewa majukumu yao.

rows.impactEn: Moderate earthquake (Magnitude 5–5.9) felt across affected regions
rows.impactSw: Tetemeko la wastani (Kipimo cha 5–5.9) limesikika katika mikoa iliyoathirika
rows.actionEn: Drop, Cover and Hold On during shaking. If outdoors, move to open spaces away from buildings, trees and power lines. If driving, stop in a safe place and stay inside the vehicle.
rows.actionSw: Anguka, Jificha na Shikilia wakati wa mtikisiko. Ukiwa nje, hamia maeneo ya wazi mbali na majengo, miti na nyaya za umeme. Ukiwa unaendesha, simama mahali salama na ubaki ndani ya gari.

rows.impactEn: Aftershocks expected for hours, days or weeks following the main shock
rows.impactSw: Mitetemeko ya kufuatilia inatarajiwa kwa masaa, siku au wiki baada ya tetemeko kuu
rows.actionEn: Be ready to take cover again at any time. Do not enter damaged buildings. Move out of weakened structures and remain outdoors or in inspected safe shelters.
rows.actionSw: Jiandae kujihifadhi tena wakati wowote. Usiingie majengo yaliyoharibika. Hama kutoka miundo iliyodhoofika na ubaki nje au katika makazi salama yaliyokaguliwa.

rows.impactEn: Damage to weak structures, mud walls and unreinforced masonry
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu wa miundo dhaifu, kuta za udongo na ujenzi wa matofali usioimarishwa
rows.actionEn: Move out of damaged buildings to open ground or official shelters. Mark dangerous structures clearly. Report damage to local authorities for inspection.
rows.actionSw: Hama kutoka majengo yaliyoharibika kwenda maeneo ya wazi au makazi rasmi. Weka alama wazi kwenye miundo hatarishi. Toa taarifa ya uharibifu kwa mamlaka za eneo kwa ajili ya ukaguzi.

rows.impactEn: Tsunami warning issued — coastal communities evacuate to higher ground immediately
rows.impactSw: Onyo la tsunami limetolewa — jamii za pwani zihame mara moja kwenda maeneo ya juu
rows.actionEn: Move at least 30 metres above sea level or 3 km inland. Do not return until officially cleared (multiple wave trains may follow the first). Take only essential items. Do not stop to watch the sea.
rows.actionSw: Hamia angalau mita 30 juu ya kiwango cha bahari au kilomita 3 ndani ya nchi kavu. Usirudi mpaka uthibitishwe rasmi (mawimbi mengi yanaweza kufuatana baada ya la kwanza). Chukua vitu vya muhimu tu. Usisimame kuangalia bahari.

rows.impactEn: Risk of injuries from falling objects, broken glass and debris during shaking
rows.impactSw: Hatari ya majeraha kutokana na vitu vinavyoanguka, vioo vilivyovunjika na mabaki wakati wa mtikisiko
rows.actionEn: Activate first aid response at health facilities. Coordinate with TRCS for psychosocial support. Clear emergency access routes to hospitals.
rows.actionSw: Anzisha huduma za kwanza katika vituo vya afya. Ratibu na Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu Tanzania (TRCS) kwa msaada wa kisaikolojia. Safisha njia za dharura kwenda hospitalini.

rows.impactEn: Disruption to power, water and communications networks
rows.impactSw: Kuvurugika kwa mitandao ya umeme, maji na mawasiliano
rows.actionEn: Stock essential supplies (water, food, medicines, torches). Charge phones and prepare radios. Report damaged power lines to TANESCO. Conserve mobile-phone battery.
rows.actionSw: Weka akiba ya mahitaji muhimu (maji, chakula, dawa, tochi). Chaji simu na andaa redio. Toa taarifa kwa TANESCO kuhusu nyaya za umeme zilizoharibika. Hifadhi betri ya simu.

rows.impactEn: Damage to infrastructure (roads, bridges, ports and airports)
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu wa miundombinu (barabara, madaraja, bandari na viwanja vya ndege)
rows.actionEn: Avoid travel until damage is assessed. Use alternative routes where available. Coordinate with TANROADS, the Tanzania Ports Authority (TPA) and TASAC on route status.
rows.actionSw: Epuka safari mpaka uharibifu utathminiwe. Tumia njia mbadala zinapopatikana. Ratibu na TANROADS, Mamlaka ya Bandari Tanzania (TPA) na TASAC kuhusu hali ya njia.

rows.impactEn: Risk of secondary fires from broken gas pipes and electrical lines
rows.impactSw: Hatari ya moto wa pili kutokana na mabomba ya gesi na nyaya za umeme zilizovunjika
rows.actionEn: Turn off gas, electricity and water supply at the main switch if safe to do so. Do not light matches or candles until you confirm there is no gas leak. Report fires to the nearest fire brigade.
rows.actionSw: Zima ugavi wa gesi, umeme na maji kwenye kitufe kikuu ikiwa ni salama kufanya hivyo. Usiwashe kibiriti au mishumaa mpaka uthibitishe hakuna gesi inayovuja. Toa taarifa ya moto kwa kikosi cha zima moto kilicho karibu.

rows.impactEn: Risk of landslides triggered by shaking on hillsides and unstable slopes
rows.impactSw: Hatari ya maporomoko ya ardhi yanayosababishwa na mtikisiko kwenye miteremko na maeneo yasiyo imara
rows.actionEn: Move away from steep slopes and cliff edges. Report observed cracks or slope movement to local authorities. Coordinate with district authorities for hillside safety inspections.
rows.actionSw: Hama mbali na miteremko mikali na kando ya majabali. Toa taarifa kwa mamlaka za eneo kuhusu nyufa au mienendo ya mteremko unayoiona. Ratibu na mamlaka za wilaya kwa ukaguzi wa usalama wa miteremko.

rows.impactEn: School and workplace closures in affected areas
rows.impactSw: Kufungwa kwa shule na sehemu za kazi katika maeneo yaliyoathirika
rows.actionEn: Follow education authority directives. Do not return to damaged buildings until cleared by inspectors. Arrange temporary studies and work elsewhere.
rows.actionSw: Fuata maelekezo ya mamlaka za elimu. Usirudi katika majengo yaliyoharibika mpaka yathibitishwe na wakaguzi. Panga masomo na kazi ya muda mahali pengine.

rows.impactEn: Possible water contamination from broken pipes and damaged sources
rows.impactSw: Uwezekano wa uchafuzi wa maji kutokana na mabomba yaliyovunjika na vyanzo vilivyoharibika
rows.actionEn: Boil or treat all drinking water. Use stored water from emergency kits. Report broken water mains to the water authority. Do not use tap water until cleared.
rows.actionSw: Chemsha au tibu maji yote ya kunywa. Tumia maji yaliyohifadhiwa kwenye kifurushi cha dharura. Toa taarifa ya mabomba makuu yaliyovunjika kwa mamlaka ya maji. Usitumie maji ya bomba mpaka yathibitishwe.

rows.impactEn: Major earthquake (Magnitude 6 or higher) causing widespread damage and casualties
rows.impactSw: Tetemeko kubwa (Kipimo cha 6 au zaidi) linalosababisha uharibifu mkubwa na waathirika wengi
rows.actionEn: Activate national emergency response through the Disaster Management Department in the Prime Minister’s Office. Mobilise JWTZ for search and rescue. Coordinate with regional and international partners (UN, IFRC, TRCS).
rows.actionSw: Anzisha hatua za dharura za kitaifa kupitia Idara ya Maafa katika Ofisi ya Waziri Mkuu. Hamasisha Jeshi la Wananchi wa Tanzania (JWTZ) kwa utafutaji na uokoaji. Ratibu na washirika wa mkoa na kimataifa (UN, IFRC, TRCS).

rows.impactEn: Major tsunami waves striking the Indian Ocean coast — life-threatening inundation
rows.impactSw: Mawimbi makubwa ya tsunami yanayopiga pwani ya Bahari ya Hindi — mafuriko hatari kwa maisha
rows.actionEn: Activate full coastal evacuation immediately. Coordinate with KMKM, the Tanzania Ports Authority (TPA) and JWTZ Marine for rescue operations. Broadcast urgent warnings via all media. Do not return to the coast until officially cleared.
rows.actionSw: Anzisha uhamishaji kamili wa pwani mara moja. Ratibu na KMKM, Mamlaka ya Bandari Tanzania (TPA) na kitengo cha baharini cha JWTZ kwa shughuli za uokoaji. Tangaza maonyo ya dharura kupitia vyombo vyote vya habari. Usirudi pwani mpaka uthibitishwe rasmi.

rows.impactEn: Widespread building collapse with people trapped under rubble
rows.impactSw: Kuporomoka kwa majengo kwa kiasi kikubwa na watu kunaswa chini ya mabaki
rows.actionEn: Deploy specialised Urban Search and Rescue (USAR) teams with sniffer dogs and listening equipment. Coordinate JWTZ engineering corps and the Fire and Rescue Force. Do not enter collapsed buildings without trained rescuers.
rows.actionSw: Tuma timu maalum za Utafutaji na Uokoaji Mijini (USAR) zenye mbwa wenye uwezo wa kunusa na vifaa vya kusikiliza. Ratibu kikosi cha uhandisi cha JWTZ na Jeshi la Zima Moto na Uokoaji. Usiingie katika majengo yaliyoporomoka bila waokoaji waliofunzwa.

rows.impactEn: Multiple fatalities and injuries requiring mass medical response
rows.impactSw: Vifo vingi na majeruhi vinavyohitaji huduma ya matibabu ya jamii kubwa
rows.actionEn: Activate hospital mass-casualty plans. Establish triage points near affected areas. Deploy mobile health teams. Provide psychosocial support for survivors and families.
rows.actionSw: Anzisha mipango ya hospitali ya majeruhi wengi. Weka vituo vya kukagua majeruhi karibu na maeneo yaliyoathirika. Tuma timu za afya zinazotembea. Toa msaada wa kisaikolojia kwa walionusurika na familia.

rows.impactEn: Major damage to schools, hospitals and government buildings
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu mkubwa wa shule, hospitali na majengo ya serikali
rows.actionEn: Conduct rapid structural assessments by qualified engineers. Establish temporary health and learning centres. Relocate essential government services to safe locations.
rows.actionSw: Fanya tathmini za haraka za miundo na wahandisi wenye sifa. Anzisha vituo vya muda vya afya na masomo. Hamishia huduma muhimu za serikali kwenye maeneo salama.

rows.impactEn: Major damage to lifelines (water, power, gas and communications) for days or weeks
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu mkubwa wa huduma muhimu (maji, umeme, gesi na mawasiliano) kwa siku au wiki
rows.actionEn: Use alternative communication (radios, satellite phones). Coordinate utility restoration with TANESCO and telecom operators. Provide emergency water trucking to affected communities. Prioritise lifelines for hospitals.
rows.actionSw: Tumia mawasiliano mbadala (redio, simu za satelaiti). Ratibu urejeshaji wa huduma na TANESCO na watoa huduma za mawasiliano. Sambaza maji kwa malori ya dharura kwa jamii zilizoathirika. Weka kipaumbele kwa huduma muhimu kwa hospitali.

rows.impactEn: Risk of disease outbreak in displaced populations and damaged sanitation systems
rows.impactSw: Hatari ya milipuko ya magonjwa katika makundi yaliyohamishwa na mifumo ya usafi iliyoharibika
rows.actionEn: Provide clean water and sanitation in shelters. Vaccinate displaced populations against cholera and other waterborne diseases. Deploy mobile health units. Conduct surveillance for disease outbreaks.
rows.actionSw: Toa maji safi na usafi katika makazi. Chanja makundi yaliyohamishwa dhidi ya kipindupindu na magonjwa mengine yanayotokana na maji. Tuma vitengo vya afya vinavyotembea. Fanya ufuatiliaji wa milipuko ya magonjwa.

rows.impactEn: Long-term displacement of thousands of households
rows.impactSw: Uhamishaji wa muda mrefu wa maelfu ya kaya
rows.actionEn: Establish official mass shelters. Coordinate long-term resettlement plans with district authorities. Provide food, water and protection for displaced families. Assist those with special needs.
rows.actionSw: Anzisha makazi rasmi ya pamoja. Ratibu mipango ya makazi ya kudumu na mamlaka za wilaya. Toa chakula, maji na ulinzi kwa kaya zilizohama. Saidia wenye uhitaji maalum.

rows.impactEn: Major economic damage to affected regions
rows.impactSw: Uharibifu mkubwa wa kiuchumi kwa mikoa iliyoathirika
rows.actionEn: Coordinate emergency cash and food assistance. Develop recovery and reconstruction programmes with district authorities. Provide reconstruction grants for damaged homes and businesses. Engage development partners.
rows.actionSw: Ratibu msaada wa dharura wa fedha na chakula. Tengeneza programu za urejeshaji na ujenzi upya na mamlaka za wilaya. Toa ruzuku za ujenzi upya kwa nyumba na biashara zilizoharibika. Shirikisha washirika wa maendeleo.

rows.impactEn: Risk of strong aftershocks for weeks causing further building collapse
rows.impactSw: Hatari ya mitetemeko mikubwa ya kufuatilia kwa wiki kadhaa inayoweza kusababisha kuporomoka zaidi kwa majengo
rows.actionEn: Do not re-enter damaged buildings until cleared by structural engineers. Mark and cordon off unsafe structures. Coordinate continuous seismic monitoring with the Geological Survey of Tanzania (GST).
rows.actionSw: Usiingie tena katika majengo yaliyoharibika mpaka yathibitishwe na wahandisi wa miundo. Weka alama na vizuizi karibu na miundo isiyo salama. Ratibu ufuatiliaji unaoendelea wa mitetemeko na Wakala wa Jiolojia Tanzania (GST).

rows.impactEn: National emergency response required: search and rescue, military deployment, international assistance
rows.impactSw: Hatua za dharura za kitaifa zinahitajika: utafutaji na uokoaji, kupelekwa kwa jeshi, msaada wa kimataifa
rows.actionEn: Coordinate national resources through the Disaster Management Department in the Prime Minister’s Office. Engage international partners (UN, IFRC, INSARAG). Deploy specialised teams for medical, structural and humanitarian support.
rows.actionSw: Ratibu rasilimali za kitaifa kupitia Idara ya Maafa katika Ofisi ya Waziri Mkuu. Shirikisha washirika wa kimataifa (UN, IFRC, INSARAG). Tuma timu maalum za matibabu, miundo na huduma za kibinadamu.

rows.impactEn: Reports of unusual disease cases or unusual patterns of illness in humans (Category 1: zoonotic and other infectious diseases)
rows.impactSw: Taarifa za visa visivyo vya kawaida vya magonjwa au mienendo isiyo ya kawaida ya magonjwa kwa binadamu (Kategoria ya 1: magonjwa ya kuambukizwa na yanayotokana na wanyama)
rows.actionEn: Strengthen surveillance through Integrated Disease Surveillance and Response (IDSR). CHWs and HCWs report signals via electronic Event-Based Surveillance (e-EBS). Rapid Response Teams verify reports within 24 hours.
rows.actionSw: Imarisha ufuatiliaji kupitia Mfumo wa Ufuatiliaji na Kukabiliana na Magonjwa (IDSR). CHW na HCW watoe taarifa kupitia Mfumo wa Kielektroniki wa Ufuatiliaji wa Matukio (e-EBS). Timu za Kukabiliana na Dharura zithibitishe taarifa ndani ya saa 24.

rows.impactEn: Outbreak of priority disease in a neighbouring country (Uganda, Kenya, Burundi, Rwanda, DRC, Zambia, Malawi or Mozambique)
rows.impactSw: Mlipuko wa ugonjwa wa kipaumbele katika nchi jirani (Uganda, Kenya, Burundi, Rwanda, DRC, Zambia, Malawi au Msumbiji)
rows.actionEn: Enhance screening at points of entry (Mutukula, Namanga, Tunduma, Kasumulu, Kabanga, Sirari, Horohoro, Holili and others). Coordinate with cross-border teams. Activate the Public Health Emergency Operation Centre (PHEOC) for monitoring.
rows.actionSw: Imarisha uchunguzi katika maeneo ya kuingia nchini (Mutukula, Namanga, Tunduma, Kasumulu, Kabanga, Sirari, Horohoro, Holili na mengineyo). Ratibu na timu za mipakani. Anzisha Kituo cha Operesheni za Dharura za Afya ya Umma (PHEOC) kwa ufuatiliaji.

rows.impactEn: Reports of unusual animal deaths or disease in livestock or wildlife (potential zoonotic risk)
rows.impactSw: Taarifa za vifo visivyo vya kawaida vya wanyama au magonjwa katika mifugo au wanyamapori (uwezekano wa hatari ya kuambukizwa kwa binadamu)
rows.actionEn: District Veterinary Officers (DVOs) investigate reports. Coordinate with Tanzania Veterinary Laboratory Agency (TVLA) for sample testing. Share findings with Ministry of Health through One Health Section in the Prime Minister’s Office.
rows.actionSw: Maafisa Mifugo wa Wilaya (DVOs) wachunguze taarifa. Ratibu na Wakala wa Maabara ya Mifugo Tanzania (TVLA) kwa kupima sampuli. Shiriki matokeo na Wizara ya Afya kupitia Idara ya Afya Moja katika Ofisi ya Waziri Mkuu.

rows.impactEn: Seasonal conditions favourable for disease transmission (rains favouring cholera, malaria, mosquito-borne disease or Rift Valley fever)
rows.impactSw: Hali ya msimu inayofaa kwa kuenea kwa magonjwa (mvua zinazofaa kwa kipindupindu, malaria, magonjwa yanayoenezwa na mbu au homa ya Bonde la Ufa)
rows.actionEn: Strengthen water and sanitation services. Promote indoor residual spraying and bednets. Coordinate with TMA for seasonal forecasts. Pre-position medicines and vaccines through MSD.
rows.actionSw: Imarisha huduma za maji na usafi. Hamasisha unyunyiziaji wa dawa ndani ya nyumba na vyandarua. Ratibu na Mamlaka ya Hali ya Hewa Tanzania (TMA) kwa utabiri wa msimu. Weka tayari dawa na chanjo kupitia Bohari Kuu ya Dawa (MSD).

rows.impactEn: Increasing antimicrobial resistance (AMR) signals in human or animal infections (Category 2: AMR)
rows.impactSw: Kuongezeka kwa dalili za usugu wa dawa (AMR) katika maambukizi ya binadamu au wanyama (Kategoria ya 2: AMR)
rows.actionEn: Strengthen Antimicrobial Stewardship Programmes (ASP) at hospitals. Enforce prescription-only access to antibiotics. Coordinate with the Multi-Sectoral Coordinating Committee under the National Action Plan for AMR (NAP-AMR 2.0, 2023–2028). Train prescribers on rational use.
rows.actionSw: Imarisha Programu za Usimamizi wa Dawa za Kuua Viini (ASP) katika hospitali. Tekeleza kanuni ya dawa kutolewa tu kwa cheti cha daktari. Ratibu na Kamati ya Uratibu wa Kisekta Mbalimbali chini ya Mpango wa Kitaifa wa AMR (NAP-AMR 2.0, 2023–2028). Toa mafunzo kwa watoaji wa dawa kuhusu matumizi sahihi.

rows.impactEn: Reports of food safety risks (aflatoxin in maize and groundnuts, food contamination, foodborne illness clusters) (Category 4: food safety)
rows.impactSw: Taarifa za hatari za usalama wa chakula (aflatoxin katika mahindi na karanga, uchafuzi wa chakula, makundi ya magonjwa yanayotokana na chakula) (Kategoria ya 4: usalama wa chakula)
rows.actionEn: Coordinate food testing through TBS, TMDA and Government Chemist Laboratory Authority (GCLA). Strengthen post-harvest handling for cereals and groundnuts. Advise on safe drying and storage. Investigate suspected food poisoning clusters.
rows.actionSw: Ratibu upimaji wa chakula kupitia TBS, TMDA na Wakala wa Maabara ya Mkemia Mkuu wa Serikali (GCLA). Imarisha mbinu za baada ya mavuno kwa nafaka na karanga. Shauri kuhusu kukausha na kuhifadhi salama. Chunguza makundi yanayodhaniwa kuwa ya sumu ya chakula.

rows.impactEn: Environmental and chemical health risks (water contamination, air pollution, occupational exposure) (Category 5: environmental health)
rows.impactSw: Hatari za afya za mazingira na kemikali (uchafuzi wa maji, uchafuzi wa hewa, kuathirika kazini) (Kategoria ya 5: afya ya mazingira)
rows.actionEn: Coordinate with NEMC, OSHA and the Government Chemist Laboratory Authority (GCLA). Test water sources, air and chemical exposures. Advise on protective equipment for workers. Investigate environmental complaints.
rows.actionSw: Ratibu na Baraza la Taifa la Hifadhi na Usimamizi wa Mazingira (NEMC), Wakala wa Usalama na Afya Kazini (OSHA) na Wakala wa Maabara ya Mkemia Mkuu wa Serikali (GCLA). Pima vyanzo vya maji, hewa na kemikali. Shauri kuhusu vifaa vya kujikinga kwa wafanyakazi. Chunguza malalamiko ya mazingira.

rows.impactEn: Climate-related health risks (heat-illness during dry seasons, expansion of mosquito range to higher altitudes) (Category 6: climate change health threats)
rows.impactSw: Hatari za afya zinazohusiana na tabianchi (magonjwa ya joto wakati wa msimu wa ukame, kuenea kwa mbu kwenda maeneo ya juu) (Kategoria ya 6: vitisho vya afya kutokana na mabadiliko ya tabianchi)
rows.actionEn: Coordinate with TMA on heat-wave forecasts. Provide heat-safety advice for outdoor workers, schools and elderly people. Strengthen vector control in newly affected areas. Monitor climate-sensitive disease patterns.
rows.actionSw: Ratibu na Mamlaka ya Hali ya Hewa Tanzania (TMA) kuhusu utabiri wa mawimbi ya joto. Toa ushauri wa usalama wa joto kwa wafanyakazi wa nje, shule na wazee. Imarisha udhibiti wa wadudu katika maeneo yaliyoathirika kwa mara ya kwanza. Fuatilia mienendo ya magonjwa yanayoathirika na hali ya hewa.

rows.impactEn: Vulnerable groups (children under five, the elderly, pregnant women, people with chronic illness or disabilities) at higher risk
rows.impactSw: Makundi yaliyo hatarini (watoto chini ya miaka mitano, wazee, wajawazito, wenye magonjwa sugu au ulemavu) wapo katika hatari kubwa
rows.actionEn: Special groups including people with disabilities, children and the elderly should be given early warning information and appropriate measures should be taken by the community concerned
rows.actionSw: Makundi maalum ikijumuisha watu wenye ulemavu, watoto na wazee wapatiwe taarifa ya tahadhari ya mapema na hatua stahiki zichukuliwe na jamii husika

rows.impactEn: Need for community awareness on disease prevention, food safety and reporting of suspect cases
rows.impactSw: Haja ya kuelimisha jamii kuhusu kuzuia magonjwa, usalama wa chakula na kutoa taarifa za visa vyenye dalili
rows.actionEn: Conduct risk communication through radio, mosques, churches, markets and community meetings. Distribute information cards. Train community influencers and religious leaders.
rows.actionSw: Fanya mawasiliano ya hatari kupitia redio, misikitini, makanisani, masokoni na mikutano ya jamii. Sambaza kadi za taarifa. Toa mafunzo kwa viongozi wa jamii na viongozi wa dini.

rows.impactEn: Need for pre-positioning of medical supplies, PPE, laboratory reagents and vaccines
rows.impactSw: Haja ya kuweka tayari vifaa vya matibabu, vifaa vya kujikinga (PPE), kemikali za maabara na chanjo
rows.actionEn: Stock essential medicines, vaccines and personal protective equipment at health facilities. Coordinate logistics with the Medical Stores Department (MSD). Ensure cold chain for vaccines is maintained.
rows.actionSw: Weka akiba ya dawa muhimu, chanjo na vifaa vya kujikinga binafsi katika vituo vya afya. Ratibu usafirishaji na Bohari Kuu ya Dawa (MSD). Hakikisha mfumo wa baridi wa chanjo unaendelea.

rows.impactEn: Need for multi-sectoral coordination under the One Health approach
rows.impactSw: Haja ya uratibu wa kisekta mbalimbali chini ya mkabala wa Afya Moja (One Health)
rows.actionEn: Activate One Health Section coordination meetings (PMO). Engage Ministry of Health, Ministry of Livestock and Fisheries, Ministry of Natural Resources and Tourism, Vice President’s Office (Environment), Ministry of Agriculture and PO-RALG. Align with the National One Health Strategic Plan 2022–2027.
rows.actionSw: Anzisha mikutano ya uratibu ya Idara ya Afya Moja (Ofisi ya Waziri Mkuu). Shirikisha Wizara ya Afya, Wizara ya Mifugo na Uvuvi, Wizara ya Maliasili na Utalii, Ofisi ya Makamu wa Rais (Mazingira), Wizara ya Kilimo na Ofisi ya Rais TAMISEMI (PO-RALG). Endana na Mpango wa Kitaifa wa Afya Moja 2022–2027.

rows.impactEn: Confirmed cases of priority disease in one or more districts (Category 1: cholera, Marburg, Ebola, Rift Valley fever, anthrax, rabies, brucellosis or sleeping sickness)
rows.impactSw: Visa vilivyothibitishwa vya ugonjwa wa kipaumbele katika wilaya moja au zaidi (Kategoria ya 1: kipindupindu, Marburg, Ebola, homa ya Bonde la Ufa, kimeta, kichaa cha mbwa, brucellosis au ugonjwa wa malale)
rows.actionEn: Activate national outbreak response through the Ministry of Health and One Health Section (PMO). Deploy Rapid Response Teams. Declare outbreak under International Health Regulations (IHR) 2005 if applicable.
rows.actionSw: Anzisha hatua za kitaifa za kukabiliana na mlipuko kupitia Wizara ya Afya na Idara ya Afya Moja (Ofisi ya Waziri Mkuu). Tuma Timu za Kukabiliana na Dharura. Tangaza mlipuko chini ya Kanuni za Kimataifa za Afya (IHR) 2005 ikiwa inafaa.

rows.impactEn: Healthcare workers at high risk of infection from confirmed cases
rows.impactSw: Wahudumu wa afya wapo katika hatari kubwa ya kuambukizwa kutoka kwa visa vilivyothibitishwa
rows.actionEn: Provide PPE (gloves, masks, gowns, goggles). Train healthcare workers on infection prevention and control (IPC). Set up dedicated triage and isolation units. Vaccinate at-risk workers where vaccines exist.
rows.actionSw: Toa vifaa vya kujikinga (mitandio, barakoa, mavazi, miwani). Toa mafunzo kwa wahudumu wa afya kuhusu kuzuia na kudhibiti maambukizi (IPC). Weka vituo maalum vya uchunguzi na kutenganisha. Chanja wahudumu walio hatarini ambapo chanjo zipo.

rows.impactEn: Need for contact tracing of all confirmed and probable cases
rows.impactSw: Haja ya kufuatilia waliokutana na wagonjwa kwa visa vyote vilivyothibitishwa na vinavyodhaniwa
rows.actionEn: Deploy trained contact tracing teams. Identify and follow up contacts daily for the disease incubation period. Isolate symptomatic contacts. Coordinate with PO-RALG for community engagement.
rows.actionSw: Tuma timu zilizofunzwa za kufuatilia waliokutana. Tambua na fuatilia waliokutana kila siku kwa kipindi cha kuatamia cha ugonjwa. Tenga waliokutana wenye dalili. Ratibu na Ofisi ya Rais TAMISEMI (PO-RALG) kwa ushirikiano wa jamii.

rows.impactEn: Hospital outbreak of multidrug-resistant infections (Category 2: AMR)
rows.impactSw: Mlipuko wa hospitalini wa maambukizi yasiyotibika kwa dawa nyingi (Kategoria ya 2: AMR)
rows.actionEn: Activate hospital Infection Prevention and Control (IPC) committee. Conduct microbiological investigation through reference laboratories. Isolate affected patients. Report to the Multi-Sectoral Coordinating Committee for AMR. Review prescribing practices.
rows.actionSw: Anzisha kamati ya kuzuia na kudhibiti maambukizi (IPC) ya hospitali. Fanya uchunguzi wa kimaabara kupitia maabara za rufaa. Tenga wagonjwa walioathirika. Toa taarifa kwa Kamati ya Uratibu wa Kisekta Mbalimbali wa AMR. Kagua mbinu za kuandika dawa.

rows.impactEn: Confirmed food safety incident or foodborne illness outbreak (Category 4: e.g. aflatoxin poisoning, contaminated water, mass food poisoning)
rows.impactSw: Tukio lililothibitishwa la usalama wa chakula au mlipuko wa ugonjwa unaotokana na chakula (Kategoria ya 4: mfano sumu ya aflatoxin, maji yaliyochafuka, sumu ya chakula kwa watu wengi)
rows.actionEn: Trace contaminated food source through TBS, TMDA and GCLA. Recall affected products from markets. Treat affected patients. Coordinate with the Ministry of Agriculture and Ministry of Livestock and Fisheries for source control.
rows.actionSw: Fuatilia chanzo cha chakula kilichochafuka kupitia TBS, TMDA na Wakala wa Maabara ya Mkemia Mkuu wa Serikali (GCLA). Ondoa bidhaa zilizoathirika kutoka masokoni. Tibu wagonjwa walioathirika. Ratibu na Wizara ya Kilimo na Wizara ya Mifugo na Uvuvi kwa udhibiti wa chanzo.

rows.impactEn: Environmental or chemical exposure event (Category 5: e.g. industrial spill, mining-area contamination, mass pesticide exposure)
rows.impactSw: Tukio la kuathirika na mazingira au kemikali (Kategoria ya 5: mfano kumwagika kwa kiwanda, uchafuzi wa eneo la migodi, kuathirika kwa madawa ya wadudu kwa watu wengi)
rows.actionEn: Coordinate response with NEMC, OSHA, GCLA and the relevant industry. Evacuate affected areas if needed. Provide medical care to exposed persons. Conduct decontamination. Investigate the cause and enforce regulations.
rows.actionSw: Ratibu juhudi na NEMC, OSHA, Wakala wa Maabara ya Mkemia Mkuu wa Serikali (GCLA) na sekta husika. Hamisha maeneo yaliyoathirika ikihitajika. Toa huduma za matibabu kwa walioathirika. Fanya usafishaji. Chunguza chanzo na tekeleza kanuni.

rows.impactEn: Cross-border transmission risk requiring screening and movement restrictions
rows.impactSw: Hatari ya kuenea mipakani inayohitaji uchunguzi na vizuizi vya safari
rows.actionEn: Strengthen screening at points of entry. Coordinate cross-border meetings with Uganda, Kenya, Burundi, Rwanda and other neighbours. Restrict non-essential travel from affected districts. Report to WHO under IHR.
rows.actionSw: Imarisha uchunguzi katika maeneo ya kuingia nchini. Ratibu mikutano ya mipakani na Uganda, Kenya, Burundi, Rwanda na nchi nyingine jirani. Punguza safari zisizo za lazima kutoka wilaya zilizoathirika. Toa taarifa kwa WHO chini ya IHR.

rows.impactEn: Confirmed link to animals or environment requiring animal-side intervention (livestock vaccination, culling, environmental control)
rows.impactSw: Uhusiano uliothibitishwa na wanyama au mazingira unaohitaji hatua za upande wa wanyama (chanjo ya mifugo, kuua wanyama walioambukizwa, udhibiti wa mazingira)
rows.actionEn: Coordinate with the Ministry of Livestock and Fisheries, TVLA and the Tanzania Wildlife Research Institute (TAWIRI). Implement animal vaccination campaigns. Restrict movement of livestock and animal products. Engage TANAPA and TAWA for wildlife coordination.
rows.actionSw: Ratibu na Wizara ya Mifugo na Uvuvi, Wakala wa Maabara ya Mifugo Tanzania (TVLA) na Taasisi ya Utafiti wa Wanyamapori Tanzania (TAWIRI). Tekeleza kampeni za chanjo za mifugo. Punguza uhamishaji wa mifugo na bidhaa za mifugo. Shirikisha TANAPA na TAWA kwa uratibu wa wanyamapori.

rows.impactEn: Need for treatment units, isolation facilities and surge capacity at designated hospitals
rows.impactSw: Haja ya vitengo vya matibabu, vituo vya kutenganisha na uwezo wa ziada katika hospitali zilizoteuliwa
rows.actionEn: Establish or upgrade isolation units at designated hospitals. Provide medical supplies, oxygen and supportive care. Deploy mobile health teams. Transfer severe cases to referral facilities.
rows.actionSw: Anzisha au boresha vitengo vya kutenganisha katika hospitali zilizoteuliwa. Toa vifaa vya matibabu, hewa ya oksijeni na huduma za matibabu ya kuokoa maisha. Tuma timu za afya zinazotembea. Hamisha visa vikali kwenda hospitali za rufaa.

rows.impactEn: Misinformation, rumours and stigma spreading in affected communities
rows.impactSw: Habari za uongo, uvumi na unyanyapaa vinavyoenea katika jamii zilizoathirika
rows.actionEn: Activate national Risk Communication and Community Engagement (RCCE) teams. Counter rumours through trusted leaders, radio and social media. Distribute information cards. Engage religious leaders, traditional healers and youth groups.
rows.actionSw: Anzisha timu za kitaifa za Mawasiliano ya Hatari na Ushirikiano wa Jamii (RCCE). Pinga uvumi kupitia viongozi wanaoaminika, redio na mitandao ya kijamii. Sambaza kadi za taarifa. Shirikisha viongozi wa dini, waganga wa jadi na vikundi vya vijana.

rows.impactEn: Need for safe and dignified burials for haemorrhagic fevers and other high-risk diseases
rows.impactSw: Haja ya mazishi salama na yenye heshima kwa magonjwa ya kuvuja damu na magonjwa mengine yenye hatari kubwa
rows.actionEn: Implement safe and dignified burial procedures by trained teams. Provide PPE for burial teams. Engage religious and traditional leaders on alternatives that respect culture and reduce risk.
rows.actionSw: Tekeleza taratibu za mazishi salama na yenye heshima na timu zilizofunzwa. Toa vifaa vya kujikinga kwa timu za mazishi. Shirikisha viongozi wa dini na wa jadi kuhusu njia mbadala zinazoheshimu utamaduni na kupunguza hatari.

rows.impactEn: Need for rapid laboratory confirmation and biosafety controls (Category 3: biosafety and biosecurity)
rows.impactSw: Haja ya uthibitisho wa haraka wa maabara na udhibiti wa usalama wa kibaiolojia (Kategoria ya 3: usalama wa kibaiolojia na kibiosekuriti)
rows.actionEn: Coordinate sample transport to NIMR, MUHAS or designated reference laboratories. Activate mobile laboratory if available. Ensure biosafety and biosecurity standards are followed. Share results within 24–48 hours.
rows.actionSw: Ratibu usafirishaji wa sampuli kwenda Taasisi ya Utafiti wa Tiba Tanzania (NIMR), MUHAS au maabara za rufaa zilizoteuliwa. Anzisha maabara inayotembea ikiwa inapatikana. Hakikisha viwango vya usalama wa kibaiolojia na kibiosekuriti vinafuatwa. Shiriki matokeo ndani ya saa 24–48.

rows.impactEn: Widespread transmission of high-consequence disease across multiple regions or districts
rows.impactSw: Kuenea kwa ugonjwa wa hatari kubwa katika mikoa au wilaya nyingi
rows.actionEn: Declare a public health emergency under the Disaster Management Act No. 6 of 2022. Activate the National Disaster Management Council (TADMAC). Coordinate national response through the PMO Disaster Management Department.
rows.actionSw: Tangaza dharura ya afya ya umma chini ya Sheria ya Usimamizi wa Maafa Na. 6 ya 2022. Anzisha Baraza la Kitaifa la Usimamizi wa Maafa (TADMAC). Ratibu juhudi za kitaifa kupitia Idara ya Maafa ya Ofisi ya Waziri Mkuu.

rows.impactEn: High case fatality rate or rapid disease spread (e.g. similar to Marburg Kagera 2023, with case fatality rate of 66.7 per cent)
rows.impactSw: Kiwango kikubwa cha vifo au kuenea kwa kasi kwa ugonjwa (mfano kama Marburg Kagera mwaka 2023, kiwango cha vifo asilimia 66.7)
rows.actionEn: Maximise patient survival through early case detection, supportive care and use of treatment protocols. Coordinate with WHO for technical support and treatment options. • deploy specialist medical teams.
rows.actionSw: Ongeza nafasi ya kunusurika kwa wagonjwa kupitia kugundua mapema, huduma za matibabu na kutumia miongozo ya matibabu. Ratibu na WHO kwa msaada wa kitaalamu na chaguzi za matibabu. Tuma timu maalum za matibabu.

rows.impactEn: Healthcare system overwhelmed by large numbers of cases
rows.impactSw: Mfumo wa afya unalemewa na idadi kubwa ya wagonjwa
rows.actionEn: Activate hospital surge plans. Convert facilities to dedicated treatment units. Deploy military medical teams (JWTZ Medical Corps). Request international medical support through WHO and partners.
rows.actionSw: Anzisha mipango ya kuongeza uwezo wa hospitali. Geuza vituo kuwa vitengo maalum vya matibabu. Tuma timu za matibabu za jeshi (Kitengo cha Matibabu cha JWTZ). Omba msaada wa matibabu wa kimataifa kupitia WHO na washirika.

rows.impactEn: Mass casualty event (Category 7: large-scale road traffic accident, building collapse, fire, marine accident or industrial disaster requiring trauma care)
rows.impactSw: Tukio la majeruhi wengi (Kategoria ya 7: ajali kubwa ya barabarani, kuporomoka kwa jengo, moto, ajali ya majini au maafa ya viwandani yanayohitaji huduma za majeraha)
rows.actionEn: Activate hospital mass-casualty plans and triage protocols. Coordinate with the Fire and Rescue Force, JWTZ Medical Corps and TRCS. Establish forward triage and emergency transport. Provide blood products and surgical capacity.
rows.actionSw: Anzisha mipango ya hospitali ya majeruhi wengi na taratibu za uchunguzi. Ratibu na Jeshi la Zima Moto na Uokoaji, Kitengo cha Matibabu cha JWTZ na Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu Tanzania (TRCS). Weka vituo vya uchunguzi vya mbele na usafirishaji wa dharura. Toa damu na uwezo wa upasuaji.

rows.impactEn: Multiple deaths requiring mass casualty management and dignified burial
rows.impactSw: Vifo vingi vinavyohitaji usimamizi wa majeruhi wengi na mazishi yenye heshima
rows.actionEn: Coordinate safe and dignified burial protocols nationally. Provide psychosocial support to bereaved families and frontline workers. Activate Tanzania Red Cross Society (TRCS) and faith-based organisations.
rows.actionSw: Ratibu kanuni za mazishi salama na yenye heshima kitaifa. Toa msaada wa kisaikolojia kwa familia zilizofiwa na wafanyakazi wa mstari wa mbele. Anzisha Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu Tanzania (TRCS) na mashirika ya kidini.

rows.impactEn: International notification required under International Health Regulations (IHR) 2005
rows.impactSw: Taarifa ya kimataifa inahitajika chini ya Kanuni za Kimataifa za Afya (IHR) 2005
rows.actionEn: The Ministry of Health IHR National Focal Point notifies WHO within 24 hours of the public health event. Share daily situation reports. Coordinate with the East African Community (EAC), SADC and Africa CDC.
rows.actionSw: Kituo Kikuu cha Kitaifa cha IHR cha Wizara ya Afya kitoe taarifa kwa WHO ndani ya saa 24 baada ya tukio la afya ya umma. Shiriki ripoti za kila siku za hali. Ratibu na Jumuiya ya Afrika Mashariki (EAC), SADC na Africa CDC.

rows.impactEn: Severe nutrition emergency (Category 7: child malnutrition crisis, IPC Phase 3 Crisis or higher in affected districts)
rows.impactSw: Dharura kubwa ya lishe (Kategoria ya 7: mgogoro wa utapiamlo wa watoto, IPC Awamu ya 3 ya Mgogoro au zaidi katika wilaya zilizoathirika)
rows.actionEn: Activate emergency nutrition screening at health facilities. Distribute therapeutic food (RUTF) to severely malnourished children. Deploy mobile health teams. Provide supplementary feeding at schools and health centres. Coordinate with UNICEF, WFP and TRCS.
rows.actionSw: Anzisha uchunguzi wa dharura wa lishe katika vituo vya afya. Sambaza chakula cha matibabu (RUTF) kwa watoto wenye utapiamlo mkali. Tuma timu za afya zinazotembea. Toa chakula cha ziada shuleni na katika vituo vya afya. Ratibu na UNICEF, WFP na Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu Tanzania (TRCS).

rows.impactEn: Maternal and child health emergency (Category 7: surge in maternal mortality, neonatal deaths or pregnancy complications during emergencies)
rows.impactSw: Dharura ya afya ya mama na mtoto (Kategoria ya 7: kuongezeka kwa vifo vya wajawazito, vifo vya watoto wachanga au matatizo ya ujauzito wakati wa dharura)
rows.actionEn: Maintain emergency obstetric and newborn care (EmONC) at health facilities. Deploy mobile maternal health teams. Ensure safe deliveries and referral pathways. Protect cold-chain access for vaccines and oxytocin. Coordinate with Reproductive and Child Health (RCH) services.
rows.actionSw: Endeleza huduma za dharura za uzazi na mtoto mchanga (EmONC) katika vituo vya afya. Tuma timu za afya ya mama zinazotembea. Hakikisha uzazi salama na njia za rufaa. Linda upatikanaji wa mfumo wa baridi kwa chanjo na oxytocin. Ratibu na huduma za Afya ya Uzazi na Mtoto (RCH).

rows.impactEn: Mental health and psychosocial crisis affecting survivors, bereaved families and frontline workers (Category 7: post-emergency mental health emergency)
rows.impactSw: Mgogoro wa afya ya akili na kisaikolojia unaowaathiri walionusurika, familia zilizofiwa na wafanyakazi wa mstari wa mbele (Kategoria ya 7: dharura ya afya ya akili baada ya dharura)
rows.actionEn: Activate Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS) services. Deploy trained counsellors to affected areas. Engage TRCS, faith-based and community organisations. Provide ongoing care for healthcare workers. Ensure access to medication for chronic mental illness.
rows.actionSw: Anzisha huduma za Afya ya Akili na Msaada wa Kisaikolojia (MHPSS). Tuma washauri waliofunzwa kwenye maeneo yaliyoathirika. Shirikisha Shirika la Msalaba Mwekundu Tanzania (TRCS), mashirika ya kidini na ya jamii. Toa huduma za muda mrefu kwa wahudumu wa afya. Hakikisha upatikanaji wa dawa kwa magonjwa sugu ya akili.

rows.impactEn: Major disruption to schools, businesses, transport and essential health services
rows.impactSw: Kuvurugika kwa kiasi kikubwa kwa shule, biashara, usafiri na huduma muhimu za afya
rows.actionEn: Coordinate continuity of essential services with PO-RALG and ministries. Ensure water, food and electricity to affected communities. Protect supply chains for medicines and vaccines through MSD. Maintain immunisation, HIV, TB and chronic-disease services.
rows.actionSw: Ratibu kuendelea kwa huduma muhimu na Ofisi ya Rais TAMISEMI (PMO-RALG) na wizara. Hakikisha maji, chakula na umeme kwa jamii zilizoathirika. Linda mifumo ya ugavi wa dawa na chanjo kupitia Bohari Kuu ya Dawa (MSD). Endeleza huduma za chanjo, VVU, TB na magonjwa sugu.

rows.impactEn: Long-term recovery and rebuilding of health system and affected livelihoods
rows.impactSw: Urejeshaji wa muda mrefu na ujenzi upya wa mfumo wa afya na maisha yaliyoathirika
rows.actionEn: Develop recovery and reconstruction programmes. Strengthen IDSR, e-EBS and laboratory systems for future events. Provide livelihood support to affected families. Document lessons learned for the One Health Strategic Plan and NAP-AMR review.
rows.actionSw: Tengeneza programu za urejeshaji na ujenzi upya. Imarisha IDSR, e-EBS na mifumo ya maabara kwa matukio ya baadaye. Toa msaada wa kimaisha kwa familia zilizoathirika. Nakili masomo yaliyojifunzwa kwa ajili ya kukagua Mpango wa Kitaifa wa Afya Moja na NAP-AMR.

rows.impactEn: National emergency response required: One Health coordination, military deployment, international assistance
rows.impactSw: Hatua za dharura za kitaifa zinahitajika: uratibu wa Afya Moja, kupelekwa kwa jeshi, msaada wa kimataifa
rows.actionEn: Coordinate national resources through the PMO Disaster Management Department and One Health Section. Engage international partners (WHO, FAO, OIE, Africa CDC, UNICEF, IFRC and UN). Deploy specialised teams for clinical care, laboratory, infection prevention, food safety, environmental and risk communication.
rows.actionSw: Ratibu rasilimali za kitaifa kupitia Idara ya Maafa ya Ofisi ya Waziri Mkuu na Idara ya Afya Moja. Shirikisha washirika wa kimataifa (WHO, FAO, OIE, Africa CDC, UNICEF, IFRC na UN). Tuma timu maalum za huduma za matibabu, maabara, kuzuia maambukizi, usalama wa chakula, mazingira na mawasiliano ya hatari.
